reviews.title: Great Stay

reviews.title: Relaxing place to stay
reviews.text: Nice kitchen, the temperature of the room was perfect, and the views were great. Parking was free and plentiful. The location is also a plus.

reviews.title: We will be back!!
reviews.text: The best hotel to stay in Las Vegas, away from all the hustle and bustle yet close enough to shows, restaurants, casinos and all what Vegas has to offer!!

reviews.title: Love The Berkley
reviews.text: We like the location with free parking. You're surrounded by shops and near by casinos without the hustle and busel of downtown or the strip. The view of the strip from our room was enough for us to enjoy.

reviews.title: Hotel visit 11 dg

reviews.title: Best property and location near the airport.
reviews.text: If you haven't been there you should give it a try. You can't beat the two bedroom unit. It has a washer and dryer. Also a large kitchen with all the ammenities.

reviews.title: Love this Property!
reviews.text: Value, rooms, location all excellent. My family and I had a wonderful time at The Berkeley. Would definitely stay there again!

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Great staff and convenient location to all the best shops and eateries. You won't be disappointed in your decision

reviews.title: Excellent

reviews.title: Excellent value
reviews.text: Rooms were quiet, very comfortable and stocked properly in the kitchen.  Wasn’t happy they claimed my pullover wasn’t left behind.

reviews.title: Comfortable Stay - Felt like Home
reviews.text: I love being able to stay at a place that has home amenities. The fact that I could cook breakfast in the morning and make my own coffee with creamer in the fridge was excellent. We were able to wash our clothes prior to leaving so no laundry at home. The bed was comfy and the view was excellent. My wife especially loved getting ready for a wedding in her own little space with her own sink. The location was perfect. A lot of restaurants and shopping but also very close to Sphere and the Strip.

reviews.title: Comfortable and huge tandem suite rooms
reviews.text: One of the best suite rooms we've to and value for the money. The room is equipped with cooking amenities and kitchen stuff.

reviews.title: Property needs a refresh
reviews.text: While I enjoyed this property it does need a refresh. Furniture showing wear and tear. Room needed a few minor repairs. Kitchen faucet not attached. Shower head finish was peeling. Had to ask repeatedly for towels and wash clothes. Love the location. Short walk to Silverton casino. Great pool area which was still open in November. Huge hot tub.

reviews.title: Fantastic stay!
reviews.text: This hotel was awesome for a family stay. It had everything we needed and it was super clean. I just felt so comfortable and I would definitely recommend to family and friends!

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Comfortable rooms and great location! Only downside are the only 3 elevators are very slow and overcrowded!

reviews.title: Super
reviews.text: Value for money super nice staff, nice spacious hotel apartments, nice beds, fluffy towels, good clean.

reviews.title: Loved everything about our stay at the Berkley!
reviews.text: In all the twenty plus years we have visited Vegas this was the first time we stayed off of the strip & our stay at the Berkley couldn’t have been better, & we were so happy to have found this place. Everything was so nice & it was a quiet, calm & peaceful place to stay. Easy check-in & checkout with friendly staff. The parking was great & it was just a short walk to the room. The room was clean & comfortable. We loved staying here. Hope we can make a return visit soon.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Room was quite large and very comfortable. The housekeeping staff were terrific.It was great that there was plenty of parking. My only comment is that the elevators are quite slow and the shower needs more water pressure.

reviews.title: Very pleased. I would return on future visits.
reviews.text: I was very pleased with this experience.  I would return again when I visit family again. I appreciated the spaciousness and the amenities,  including free parking. The full laundry  in the unit is very useful for longer stays. Only real improvement would have been a dividing door between bathroom and bedroom area.

reviews.title: Clean and quiet
reviews.text: Nice, clean and quiet for a one night stay. Nice room with decent beds. Thank you for all your additional accommodations to my requests

reviews.title: Sema business
reviews.text: We went for sema business and had a great stay, easy to get to the convention centers. Parking was plentiful.

reviews.title: First and certainly LAST visit.
reviews.text: This was my first time in Vegas and a special trip for my birthday. From the moment I arrived, I was given false information about my room accommodations and stay. There’s also an extra charge for EVERYTHING you would expect within a  normal hotel visit. I truthfully wanted to check out the following day but was explained the process for that was lengthy so I endured. The service was horrible but the room was nice. Wouldn’t recommend, much better options in Vegas for stays.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Silverton close by for food meals and entertainment. Great parking. Rooms nice but bedroom carpeting needed shampooing. AC and heat worked well. Love room darkening. Fair TV with no tv guide for times to watch or what’s playing.

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: We love it. Perfect for my family. It’s was big clean enough room for my family. Everything was close by if you need restaurant or target, gas stations.

reviews.title: Beautiful Condo Accommodations
reviews.text: This is the perfect location at an incredible price point. Nothing better than traveling condo style. It has perfect strip and mountain views . Highly recommend

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Very pleasant stay. Not far from the airport and next to the Bass Pro Shop. Had a great kitchen with cookware and utensils for cooking your own food (good money saver).

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Our first time to experience staying at "The  Berkley" & it did not disappoint. Booked via RCI & we  were most pleased . The resort is nicely situated , not so far from the strip yet it is so quiet. The 2 rooms that were assigned to us were  so spacious & private. They are actually 2 separate units each with one master bedroom  , full kitchen, living room , bathroom . Staff were friendly & accommodating. Couldn't ask for more. Our week long stay was quite comfortable. Looking forward to more future stays in this wonderful resort !

reviews.title: Great option for families
reviews.text: Everything was perfect. There was plenty of space for our large family. The rooms were clean and had everything we needed. Great location.

reviews.title: GREATNESS in one place
reviews.text: It was so convenient to stay at this centrally located hotel.  The best thing is that it provided enough space for the entire family with no one bumping into one another.  We were in town for our son's baseball tournament so having access to do laundry is a must.  What better way then to have 2 stacked washer and dryers available.  We even did some cooking for dinner and breakfast so very cost efficient when traveling.

reviews.title: Dog hair everywhere!
reviews.text: I’m not sure the rooms are being properly cleaned at this property. This was my see one time saying here and I got a 1 bdrm suite. There was dog hair on everything the bed. The couch, the chair, the carpet and rug areas. There’s dog hair all over my and my man’s belongings and we DO NOT HAVE DOGS. I also had to clean the kitchen and bathroom prior to use because it didn’t seem clean to me

reviews.title: One happy guest!
reviews.text: it's such a refreshing change to stay in a resort like this away from the casino hotel.  The location is fantastic, with all the shops, restaurants, gas station & Silverton casino right next door.  The property location is south of strip, much better area than north of strip between downtown Fremont Street. The value for the money is unbelievable, there are NO resort fee or parking fee like the hotels on the strip, yet it's very close to the airport and car rental agency.  This is a hidden gem people may not know about when visiting Las Vegas, definitely should check it out and see it for yourself.

reviews.title: The Berkley - A Great Vacatiob Place
reviews.text: We just spent a week at the Berkley at Silverton and had a great time. The rooms were clean and quiet, and the staff was always friendly and helpful. The pool, hot tub and exercise room were great. Most rooms are a full one bedroom, with a separate living area. Each unit sleeps 4. If you get two rooms together, you can share the space and sleep 8. The hotel is located right next to the Silverton Casino and the Bass Pro shop. I highly recommend this resort for you next vacation.

reviews.title: Awesome Stay at The Berkley
reviews.text: This was my second time staying at The Berkley and each stay was amazing. I love the area away from the Strip and this hideaway was quiet and surreal. The rooms are fantastic, very clean and felt like home. So like home, I cooked breakfast 2 out of the 4 days we were there. I also love the fact that having a washer/dryer inside the room was fantastic. No dirty clothes went back home. I truly would recommend The Berkley Las Vegas to friends, family and everyone!

reviews.title: Good hotel, AMAZING room!
reviews.text: The room that I stayed in was actually an apartment, with a living room, a kitchen, and a suite. It's a bit strange that the pool area is between the building and the parking lot, especially cause it's a see-through fence, but the pool area is really good as well.If you don't have a car with you, be advised and prepared to spend some time and money on transportation, because you'll most likely be using Uber/Lyft, and it costs, on average, $20 to ride between the hotel and the Strip.

reviews.title: Beautiful place, convenient, and friendly staff
reviews.text: Overall a great space for our party of 3 adults. Next door to Starbucks was great. A few minor repairs need to be made to the sinks, but it didn't disrupt our stay. Beds were comfy and staff was stellar.

reviews.title: Enjoyable Stay
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at The Berkley.  The hotel is a convenient driving location to The Strip and other attractions, as well as there are many stores and restaurants nearby that are easy to get to by foot. Our room was spacious and we were glad to have a full kitchen and washer/dryer in our unit during our stay. The bed was comfortable and the bathroom was roomy with the design of the 2 sink areas. We were completely satisfied with our hotel location and experience. We would definitely stay at The Berkley again.

reviews.title: Awesome for the price

reviews.text: Great rooms at very affordable price. Excellent resport and place to stay. Would be even better if shuttle service is provided to/from the airport; and a m ore reliable car/van shuttle service to town.

reviews.title: Don’t stay here if you want to sleep in on your check out day
reviews.text: Love staying here because it’s always clean and rooms are worth it They did not let me add late check out even though they kept sending me texts and emails about it

reviews.title: Great place off the strip
reviews.text: Great location not to  busy not  too far but not  to close to the strip right next to silverton casino bit to crowded at all

reviews.title: Affordable Long Term Stay
reviews.text: We stayed at The Berkley for 6 nights. We loved how affordable it was, the free parking, the pool, and the friendly staff. Our room was spacious and our bed was very comfortable. It really helped to have a kitchen so we could cook some meals. With a few grocery stores nearby, we saved a lot of money during our stay. We felt the location was great, making it easy for us to access the strip, Red Rock canyon, and all the other places we visited. A few negatives were that our first room smelled like smoke and we had to be moved to a lower floor with not as great a view. Staff handled it really well but it was late and we were tired from a day of traveling so we were disappointed. Also, our dishwasher had to be fixed during our stay, and our garburator didn’t work either. We also had to buy cooking necessities, like spices and had to ask for extra toilet paper, dishwashers tabs, laundry detergent, etc. Despite these drawbacks, we did enjoy our stay and we very likely will choose the Berkley for our next long term trip. Staff members were super friendly and helpful and our issues were addressed right away.

reviews.title: Don't go there!
reviews.text: Rooms need updating and help is almost impossible to get! If you want any real service, you have to go to their sister resort- The "Grandview".

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: No tips or guidelines-everything went well. Good location & easy access. Walking distance to Silverton Casino.

reviews.title: Great Place to Rest and Recover
reviews.text: We went to Vegas to see the Wizard of Oz at the Sphere. We would normally stay at other properties on the South Side of the Strip as there is plenty of available restaurants, grocery stores, and the outlet mall to keep expenses somewhat lower. The property is easy to access and only a few minutes to the strip whether you take the freeway or Las Vegas Blvd northbound from the property.

A great place to visit if you really want to relax away from all of the business of the strip. It's accessible to grocery shopping, clothes shopping, and household needs. The apartment is equipped with a full kitchen & basic cooking appliances. The restaurants at the Silverton (next door) are also amazing.

reviews.title: PERFECTION!
reviews.text: Everything about this place is PERFECT. It's FAMILY FRIENDLY. Clean. Comfortable. Welcoming. Has everything you need inside Unit, besides your extra amenities. I was happy and satisfied, and will be back!! :)

reviews.title: Location, Location, Location
reviews.text: This is a "GREAT" location. Clean room and I had a amazing view. No parking fees, no surprise fees - although, they should consider removing the resort fee since they do not have a spa or business center. They do not have room service or food delivery services; but they do have shuttle service to the Strip and Downtown.  Good restaurant choices in surrounding area and "Silverton Village".

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: This is clean, spacious property. If not stay at the Strip I would book again next time to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great location, friendly staff, good size room
reviews.text: The location was perfect, close to freeway, airport, The Strip, the stadium, and Red Rock. Easy to get to all these places without the traffic. Plenty of stores, gas stations, restaurants, and fast food places close by. That was nice if you want to save a few bucks, because eating on The Strip can be pricey. Staff was friendly and it was nice to have a condo type room for comfort. The only reason for not giving 5 stars was the uncomfortable bed/pillows and cleanliness of room. I noticed something splattered on the bathroom wall and pocket door as well as on curtains in bedroom. Looked like it had been there a while. Overall, nice place to stay, just needed to be cleaner.

reviews.title: Lovely Place
reviews.text: The Berkley was perfect for our business trip. The rooms are really nice and quiet and well equipped. I would highly recommend them.

It was great to be away from the resort and we had a relaxing weekend getaway.

reviews.text: Great place for the price. We loved the town home concept of the room and it was located right where we wanted.

reviews.text: Great stay in a very spacious apartment hotel. The staff is friendly. The hotel is large and clean. The room was very well equipped, a real big comfortable bed, a big sofa bed a little noisy. Tv, oven, fridge, microwave oven, washing machine and dryer, coffee maker, toaster... Shower and bathtub. Beautiful and large swimming pool with shade corners. Jacuzzi. Shops and restaurants nearby. Large free parking. 15 minutes from the strip. Quiet, away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Free shuttle 3 times a day if you want to go to town without a car. We loved it and will be back next year.

reviews.title: Great stay, especially for a week or more
reviews.text: This is like being in your own apartment and it comes equipped with everything you need. They offer shuttles to the strip if you want to go. But if you just need to be in Vegas and want peace and quiet you never really need to leave. IT is in a great area close to shopping and restaurants with everything you need!

reviews.title: Deluxe suite stay
reviews.text: Spacious suite with full kitchen, comfortable bed, in-suite laundry, view of Vegas, and enjoyable outdoor swimming pool.

reviews.title: Go to place if you don't want busy strip
reviews.text: Lovely hotel although a bit far out for those wanting the strip. This property is timeshare which I didn't realise at the time of booking so had to go on 90 minutes tour which turned into 6 hours!!! Three different sales people all trying to sell ridiculously high priced weeks holiday. Checkout time too early 10am..... then housekeeping knocking on door at 9.30 to see if we're ready to go. Technically self catering service so no cleaning offered. Could have done with a mop or something as the place got a bit grotty after 8 days. Git a mid stay clean but she only made the bed in main bedroom

reviews.title: A beautiful discovery in Las Vegas
reviews.text: A very clean and well equipped accommodation.We appreciated the provision in the accommodation of a washing machine and dryer.Perfect for a family trip.

reviews.text: The villa was very spacious. The bed was so comfortable and it was close to restaurants and 10 minutes from the strip. Plus they provide a shuttle to the strip if you wanna go.

reviews.text: The Night Shift front desk clerk was rude and disrespectful I lodged a complaint, the manager was in a meeting, the manager never acknowledged my complaint and the behavior continued throughout my stay

reviews.text: Just do your homework when it comes to finding the best hotel. Look for a hotel that will be good for you and family or friends

reviews.title: Modern Studio Has Everything You Need
reviews.text: Clean, modern and comfortable. The kitchenette has everything you need to prepare meals. The full size refrigerator with an ice maker was very convenient.

Lije any other establishments you have a few minor issues like ice maker didn't work in one of the adjacent units but for the most part it's an amazing set up for if you're traveling with a large group or family. Also, I'm big on cleanliness and this definitely met my cleanliness standards.

reviews.title: Awesome Vacation!
reviews.text: We had an awesome time at The Berkley. The resort was centrally located not far from the Las Vegas Strip and the resort provided shuttle service to various points of interest such as the Las Vegas Strip and Freemont Street.

reviews.title: NOT A GOOD EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: This property needs a serious change starting from front desk, maintainace , securtiy, shuttle, etc.Front Desk: the front desk personnel show a high level incopetency- you ask for something, they confirm they did it but yet they did not. Maintainace- they come after 2 days Security- had serious concerns about my safety and my child's safety in the  swimming pool as adults and children were aggressively jumping and diving in the hot tub and swimming pool. Addressed the issue to security, he did a quick walk around and that was it and people continued jumping and diving. They show no care for other people's safety- safety is not their priority.Shuttle- often late or does not show up at all

reviews.title: Great place to stay, smells amazing.
reviews.text: As soon as you walk in the smell takes over and you feel comfortable! Rooms are spacious and having a washer and dryer was an extra bonus. All staff are very friendly and helpful. Jacuzzi was amazing.

reviews.title: Such a lovely resort!
reviews.text: Honestly, this resort was fantastic! We are not shareholders or anything, just booked a 5-day vacation through a third party website, and it was great. It was our first time here. The staff was friendly, the hotel was sparkling clean, and the first thing my little guy noted in the lobby was that it smelt really good! We didn’t use it but they have shuttle service to and from the strip. By car, the strip is approximately 10 minutes away; the airport is approximately 8 minutes away. Everything you could need - target, gas stations, restaurants, shopping - is accessible by car within 5-15 minutes. Housekeeping isn’t done every day but they can come up upon request, and the front desk is available for amenities 24/7. I had a maintenance request and they arrived within minutes. We had a great time in the pool to cool off on a hot day, and although we brought our own towels, towels were available I believe under the sink in the little powder room off of the washroom in the suite.Our two-unit suite was just lovely, with each unit having its own bedroom + kitchen + washroom + living room. That was a surprise as we thought the kitchen, washroom, and living room would be shared with two closed-off bedrooms. As we were extended family vacationing together, this worked out well for us.All I can say is book the stay. The resort is on the Silverton property, which has a casino and a (free) aquarium which we didn’t get to visit but looked really great - they apparently have stingray feedings and mermaid shows. Although a family vacation with kids to Vegas sounds contradictory, it was an amazing time. We didn’t want to come home, and are already thinking about when we can come back just to stay at this hotel again!

reviews.title: Recommended apartment hotel just outside
reviews.text: Well equipped apartments near the interstate. We found everything we needed. Service a bit cumbersome: Rooms are not cleaned during the stay. If there is a lack of toilet paper, shampoo or something else, you have to pick it all up individually at the reception. Parking free of charge right outside the door. And since you have to travel by car anyway, all the highlights of Las Vegas can be reached in a few minutes.Good Price quality ratio and friendly staff.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Excellent value for money hotel apartments. We are very happy to be here again. Whether it's the room layout or the kitchen kitchenware, washing machine and all the amenities, it's really great. Parking is very convenient and the internet is good. Reservations are also convenient. Very satisfied in short! The only shortcoming was that there was no spare toilet paper, and many guests had to go to the front desk to ask for it. This is embarrassing.

reviews.title: Poor service

reviews.title: Quality size rooms!
reviews.text: Spacious rooms, huge bathrooms with hot tubs, couches and chairs are nice. Fridge is great and stove and microwave so you won’t have to eat out every meal. Breathtaking views from the higher floors.

reviews.title: Summer Vacation
reviews.text: Had a great summer vacation. Went to Summer League, Silverton Casino next door. I am not sure why Sundance Restaurant has 2 stars but it was an 8 to me.

reviews.title: Would not stay again
reviews.text: Staff are uneducated and not helpful. Property is not well maintained. 2 of the 3 elevators were inoperable. Shuttle service is unreliable. Rooms are nice enough. Beds are terribly uncomfortable. Fold out couches are basically useless for sleeping. Don't waste your time. Find another place to stay. Vegas is a big city. There have got to be hundreds of better options.

reviews.title: Home for 3 weeks
reviews.text: Came to Vegas for our daughter’s dance competition and had a great stay at the Berkeley. In room laundry was probablythe best thing as well as the fully functional kitchen that we made full use of. Location was nearby all the essentials you need including tons of food options. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text: The service, the staff and the premises was beyond what you could ask for the only complaint I do have is they do not have a shuttle to walmart and the shower needs to have a lift, but am I holding experience outside of that was exquisite!

reviews.title: COMFORT
reviews.text: Excellent location, price-benefit ratio. We had a wonderful vacation and experience in Las Vegas. I will definitely return to this resort and recommend it to my friends.

reviews.title: They need to double check reservation no.
reviews.text: To make sure to double check the booking or checking in. Someone with the same name as me and they gave my reservation to that person without looking at the reservation number. I had to wait for a while and mind you we came from a long road trip so we were tired. Otherwise room is clean. We only spent 1 day just to rest and go to another roadtrip.

reviews.title: First time visit to The Berkley
reviews.text: My wife and I are new owners and our first visit was simply OUTSTANDING and we’re sincerely looking forward to our next visit.

reviews.text: Enjoy Life at The BERKLEY aren't you can just go stand and walk around outside on the Street I Mean Strip

reviews.title: I love it here!
reviews.text: Great place to stay! Clean! Great parking ! Easy access to the strip! Always smell good! Pleasant staff!

reviews.title: First time great, Second time awful
reviews.text: Vents in the room were disgustingly dusty, I’m talking thick chicks of dust. I am pregnant and was sneezing and coughing. The shower constantly clogged up. The AC cannot be controlled by guess so I was forced to be hot and pregnant. 2/3 elevators did not work in an 18 floor building. Again, I’m pregnant and either had to wait forever for one elevator or take the steps to my room on the 9th floor. Everyone trying to checkout at 10am was insane with the elevators. Also charging $150hr for a late checkout is insaneeee!

reviews.title: REVIEW
reviews.text: Had to beg for towels -when we finally received them, they were left outside of the room in a garbage bag. Was charged $45.00 per day for cleaning but room was not cleaned until the day of departure.

reviews.title: Nice Stay
reviews.text: Nice place and right next to casino.  Liked everything but their policy that you must leave your license to get a luggage cart.  Seem petty.

reviews.title: Not a gold crown resort
reviews.text: I am honestly shocked and disappointed that this is considered a gold crown.   It needs to be re-evaluated.  Although room is modern and clean, there were several disappointments.  Things to know:  Hot tub does not work and is not hot.  They know and say they have been trying to fix, but was not working entire stay.   The GFI outlets in room are super sensitive.  I had to blow my hair dry in the living room as if I did so in bathroom, the breaker would go and leave us with no electricity.  This happened multiple times throughout stay.  The maintenance team was very responsive, but said it is a well known issue, but no resolution other than wait for them to reset. The pool is dirty with leaves in it.  The pool cushions are outdated and so bleached - I personally would not sit on them as they looked dirty as well.   There is also no concierge service - they send you somewhere else that is not helpful for suggestions.   It really needs to be better maintained to be considered a gold crown.

reviews.title: Unsatisfactory experience
reviews.text: Accommodations are not accurately represented.  Our rooms were clean but the hotel was lacking in many aspects.  Would not visit there again. Too far from the strip, taxi about $35 one way, shuttle is a joke.  Not the drivers, but the inconsistency of pickup/drop off.  Staff at this location is untruthful.  Staffing is underwhelming.  Descriptions of rooms is inaccurate.  There are no multi bedrooms, what they have is separate apartments, with a connecting mini lobby.  Hotel is difficult to locate, adjacent to a casino that hides it from view, separated by only a small parking lot.  We would not visit here again.  They call themselves a "resort" and charge a fee for that.  It''s a hotel with a pool.

reviews.title: Nice resort but bad services
reviews.text: Booked 1 BR at Berkley. Bathroom shower not working... doors and locks giving statis shock, toiletries are bad quality and gave rash

reviews.title: Nice place but needs better service
reviews.text: Booked 1 BR apartment at Berkley. The apartment was spacious and well planned. Parking is available, and plenty.But noticed few problems... and spoiled our stay.Shower was broken and doesn't work well, toiletries not good quality cause skin rash... doors and looks had static current and always shocked us when we opened it. We were worried each time we opened door 🚪.

reviews.title: April in Las Vegas, nice hotel and great weather.
reviews.text: Our fourth or fifth time staying at the Berkley and we have always been satisfied.  We rented a one bedroom apartment.  (There are also two bedroom apartments available).  If not brand new, it was fully equipped, nicely maintained, comfortable, and well sound proofed.  We never heard our neighbors.  Plenty of free parking, and the staff was pleasant and friendly.   A very convenient location.  Two minute walk to Silverton Casino, five minute drive to the strip, and two minute drive to restaurants and shopping.  There is also a lawn with chairs.  Not common in Las Vegas.   Two concerns.  Not the hotel's fault, but it was spring recess and there were a lot of families with young children.  The kids were reasonably well behaved, but they were a big presence in the common areas and pool.  As a cranky senior, I prefer things a little more tranquil.     Second, what was the hotel's fault, one of the three elevators went out on Friday and was still out when we left Monday.  It slowed things down significantly over the weekend.  Long waits and crowded elevators.  On Saturday I asked a maintenance worker about it and was told the repair service wouldn't be available until Monday.  I did bring it up to the front desk, their response was polite but unconcerned.   A pleasant place to stay for many reasons, but I was disappointed in their non response to the elevator problem.  Things can and do break down, but they should have been more proactive in correcting it.

reviews.title: Bed was good - but won't be back
reviews.text: Not going to return.  Elevator was broken, which happens, but the staff was also rude, room was not the greatest and absolutely the worst experience of all the properties in Las Vegas that RCI offers.

reviews.title: It Was Really Nice
reviews.text: I highly recommend staying at The Berkeley.  The resort is not too large; it is family-friendly, and the suite was very home-like and spacious. I stayed there because it was minutes away from a bowling tournament I was participating in with friends.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: We loved our trip. Great location as it was an easy walk to the store and quick uber to the strip. We appreciated the wonderful staff. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Bad location
reviews.text: This hotel was in direct route to airport planes fly over inch away from hotel. We would never stay here again. plus zero activities and the fitness room was dark and dingy

reviews.title: A needed get away.
reviews.text: Great location to the Casino and shops. The room was spacious and clean but the bed could be updated.  The only downside was the hot tub was broke so we couldn't go in there to relax.

reviews.title: The Berkley
reviews.text: Overall very good with the exception of the hot tub being broken the entire week and no estimate of it being fixed anytime soon.

reviews.title: Berkley Las Vegas Stay
reviews.text: We love the Berkley.  Great location to the Strip (just a short Uber ride to any of the South Resorts on the Strip.  The Silverton Casino next door has great restaurants and a nice casino.  The Pool & Rooms at the Berkley are super nice and its great the pool is open from 8:00 am - 10:00 pm every day.  Nice to be able to go soak in the hot tub after a day on the Strip or after the NASCAR races which is why we stayed at the Berkley.  Lots of free parking for the Rental Car.  Already looking forward to our next stay there.

reviews.title: Great place but beware!
reviews.text: This resort is wonderful! ❤️ However, my husband Drivers License was given to the wrong person after he returned the luggage carrier!!!! We called to contact the Front Desk manager to hopefully help others not to experience this HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE and she was very unavailable to speak with us after we were guests here during our 3 week stay. Lastly, we had a late check out and came back to our room to find out the housekeeping staff through away hundreds of dollars of our personal items, sheesh!!!We're very unhappy with these experiences....

reviews.title: Nice resort everything you need.
reviews.text: Very nice resort and look after you needs very well. Nice to have a casino right on the property. I recommend this resort.

reviews.title: Location, Location, Location
reviews.text: Great place if you don't want to be close to the strip but not in the middle of the traffic and craziness.  The freeway access is great as the property sits right at the 215 and I15 exchange so you can easily get to any part of town quickly (I spend a lot of time in Summerlin and Henderson and the access to both is great). Rooms are big and nice enough with washer/dryer and full kitchen which is nice when u are staying a full week.  Grocery store right around the corner so easy to load the fridge up with essentials and not have to pay ridiculous resort prices for drinks and small meals (just being able to cook a quick breakfast or lunch each day probably saved me $1000 for the week). You are less that 10min to the strip, 10min to Green Valley area and under 20min to Summerlin. The Silverton casino sits on the same property so you can access their gaming and restaurants as well.  Overall, I like this place and have stayed there twice.  If you want to be in the middle of the strip and use a timeshare week try the Trump or one of the Hilton properties but if you plan on renting a car and doing stuff around town this is a great place.

reviews.title: Location was perfect for my business & leisure visit.
reviews.text: Very comfortable stay. The 1-bedroom unit was wonderfully laid out. The view from the 17th floor towards the city was great. Easy access to parking lot and casino next door was in walking distance. Very close had been nice restaurants and other convenient retail locations. I enjoyed staying in a non-casino accommodation for my visit. I would definitely reserve this property in the future again.

reviews.title: Comfortable and peaceful
reviews.text: In silence, close to the city centre and the airport. Well-meaning receptionists offered us apartments with views of the city centre and the Sphere, against a backdrop of beautiful mountains. It was a very comfortable modern apartment with all the usual amenities, a great mattress on the bed in the bedroom. In the small kitchen you could cook breakfast at any time, wash, iron (there was everything you needed). Free parking. The long one-story building across the street is a casino, fish and mermaid aquarium and a unique, beautifully decorated shop for hunters and fishermen. There are plenty of cafe-restaurants in the casino if you don't like cooking yourself. We recommend visiting the Sundance Grill : waiters are hospitality gurus (special thanks for Lisa), chefs are professionals, cook very deliciously and serve large portions beautifully. The hotel has a heated swimming pool and a luggage room, which is very convenient. If we're in Las Vegas any longer, we'll stay at this hotel again.

reviews.title: Great location!
reviews.text: We loved this location, especially being next door to a full casino with restaurants. A Front Desk staff name Bre was a lovely person who rendered us outstanding customer service!!!

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Really nice resort and grounds. Absolutely nothing to complain about. There is a shuttle to the strip and Fremont street, but we did not use it.

reviews.title: Looking forward to my next visit
reviews.text: Excellent staff on board... always ready to help you...cleanness of the rooms, facilty and grounds shows the staff takes great pride working there

reviews.title: Nice timeshare
reviews.text: Everything was nice about this resort. Across the street Silverton casino with mermaid swim. Updated room, nice hot tub outside. Envigorating shower. Cooked breakfast a few days in room. Did not cook lunch or supper.

reviews.title: Excellent Stay at The Berkley Las Vegas, NV
reviews.text: The Berkley was our upgrade from the Grandview in Dec. 2023. Here in Dec. 2024 we love our decision! All Units in only 1 bldg. Great Security inside and outside driving around the Parking Lot. Very clean inside and outside. Unit configuration excellent, bedding excellent. Berkley staff very nice and supportive with all our needs. Very quiet and a very short walk over to the Silverton Casino.

reviews.title: Exceptional Stay
reviews.text: I had an exceptional stay at The Berkeley, Las Vegas. The staff were welcoming and attentive, ensuring every need was met. I’d like to add a special mention and thank one of the receptionists, Ms. Ophelia Cogat, as she went out of her way to help us with any and everything related to our stay and travel in Las Vegas. The pool area was clean and inviting, ideal for relaxing after a day of exploring. You get free parking and its proximity to shops and restaurants makes it an ideal location for staying.

reviews.text: Great resort, clean, well maintained, staff friendly and helpful, good location to restaurants and Vegas activities without the crowds,

reviews.text: Room was great. Tub and shower were still a little dirty. Hair around tub.Overall, the photos are most likely from when the Silverado was first built. Not a new hotel at all.

reviews.text: The berkley is our home away from home.  We definitely always look forward to staying here.  It's quiet.  Close enough to the strip but not too close.  Not crowded.  Plenty of FREE parking.  Silverton casino offers a variety of restaurants.  The berkley is close to shopping and other adventures.

reviews.text: This hotel is close to an Amazon Locker, a few shopping malls, less than a 5-minute drive from an AMC (Cinema), and a 15- to 20-minute drive to the Strip.The hotel is new, very beautiful, the complete room with everything, kitchen, lava clothes, bathtub, etc. And as we wanted to make tours close to vegas that catches road, it is better and easier to access than every time having to get out of the straw of the strip.And in the days we went to Las Vegas Blvd, we stopped at hotels with free parking.The hotel is perfect. reviews.title: This was a great choice for us!
reviews.text: Two friends and I stayed in a one-bedroom which included a kitchen, comfortable bathroom, and washer/dryer. The bathroom had a large tub and a large shower as well as a separate sink/vanity outside the main bathroom which is always handy. The room was clean, comfortable, and updated with quality fixtures. Parking was easy in the garage next door. There was no housekeeping service during our stay but we were directed to just ask if we needed more supplies. We did not visit the pool or fitness areas. There are plenty of shopping and restaurant options nearby but you would want a car. We had an excellent room for a great price and all three of us were happy with our stay!

reviews.title: Very comfortable stay
reviews.text: This was our first time at The Berkely, and it will not be our last time. We liked the location. Away from the Strip, close to the airport. Easy access to freeways. Grocery store less than a mile away. The 1 bedroom condo was very comfortable and quiet. The kitchen is fully stocked for cooking. Staff are friendly. As you approach the resort, it is a little confusing because the only large signage is for the Silverton casino. But the tall high rise is the resort. The casino is actually behind the resort itself. We were here on a timeshare trade. There is a sales pitch when you get your parking pass, but it is not too pushy.

reviews.title: Comfortable stay close to everything yet private
reviews.text: Very Charming active resort yet quaint and away from the hustle and bustle of Las Vegas Central. Great Casino on Property with much shopping on site and nearby. The staff was friendly and helpful. Loved my stay there!

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: This was a great place to stay off the strip. Huge rooms with a full kitchen. Easy parking and close to everything. Bathrooms had two vanities and lots of space. We would stay here again! Hot tub temperature needs to be turned up...it is not warm enough.

reviews.title: The Berkley a Great Resort
reviews.text: The Berkley in Las Vegas is a small timeshare resort, consisting of one 18 story building, with around 500 units. The building is in immaculate condition. The staff is always friendly and helpful. Although you don't get room service when staying a week or less, you can always ask and get clean towels, soap, and paper products if needed. They have an excellent weight/exercise room and a nice pool and hot tub. It is located next door to the Silverton casino, which provides several restaurants as well as a good gaming facility. Although it is next door to the casino, there was no issue with parking or crowds. One of the biggest, nicest Bass Pro Shops is connected to the casino.  It is off of the main strip, but only a 10-15 minute drive to get to the south end of the strip. Although not necessary, I recommend having a car when I stay.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel away from the Vegas Strip
reviews.text: We stayed at The Berkley in a 2 bedroom suite.  The rooms were large, beds were comfortable and each room had it's own kitchen and living room. Hotel was across from the Silverton Casino and away from the Vegas Strip which was exactly what we wanted.  We were only 15 minutes from all the action and far enough that it was peaceful and away from the crowds.  The parking was free and we were charged a one time $75 total resort fee.  Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.text: The facility was large and clean. Right off of the freeway away from the traffic of the strip. The pool and staff were fabulous! reviews.title: Hotel from hell.
reviews.text: There were 3 of us ladies who stayed at the Berkeley for 10 nights. Everything was good until 2 days before we were due to leave. We also phoned the police. Staff were very nice and sympathetic but we knew that once we returned to the UK that would be the end of it. I have emailed them on numerous occasions, but nobody wants to help. My advice to anyone staying at the Berkeley is watch your bag/purse like a hawk. DO NOT TRUST THE STAFF. We also know that this isn’t the only time something has gone missing. While we there, there was another issue with one of the owners. Would I go back there - not a chance.

reviews.title: Berkley Love
reviews.text: We had a WONDERFUL time staying at this resort!  The staff was very friendly!  The rooms were very clean and comfortable!  I loved the A & B rooms!  My grandbabies enjoyed watching the airplanes come in on the way to the airport!  The pool are was very nice and clean.  We loved all the amenities they offered and what they did not have we just went to the store to get it, example, laundry soap.  I washed everyday!  We also loved that it was away from the strip!  The Berkley is one of our favorite resorts to stay in!  Looking forward to going back!  I will be asking for the same room number so my grandbabies could watch the planes come in again!!

reviews.text: Although the Berley is well off the Strip, it was very enjoyable.  They have nice restaurants and a nice, but small, casino.  The place was nice and quiet during our stay, so the R & R was nice, too.

reviews.title: Relax in Vegas
reviews.text: Great resort to relax by the pool, enjoy the casino and restaurants within walking distance. Free parking Rooms are a good size with comfortable beds and well stocked kitchen. Staff is friendly and helpful.

We liked the room and amenities although the furniture was a little soiled. Not the best room view. Was moved from 1st room to a second. Surrounded by parking lots.  However, beautiful night view. Not a bad idea to bring extra face clothes ladies and families. When asked for more was told that's all we get.  ummm...... The front desk did offer extra laundry detergent. But we required more.

reviews.title: Our getaway at the Berkley Las Vegas.

I realized that I had been uninterrupted, unhurried,  and I had everything I needed at my fingertips I was so happy to have been able to do this in Vegas.

reviews.title: Fun in the sun

reviews.title: Our 60 wedding anniversary
reviews.text: We were here to celebrate our 60 wedding anniversary and dinner at our favorite restaurant. First time at Berkley. We were pleased with the hospitality. Everyone friendly.

(Needs to be heated!  Water was freezing so you could only set on the edge)This is a condo property and our 1 bedroom was quite large, great kitchen. Bathroom was huge and there was a separate makeup area with sink. Across from that was washer and dryer. I have never seen this setup. Very clean, great staff and no pressure to take timeshare tour. They asked politely, and we declined. Next to Silverton casino which was quite nice. Lots of restaurants there or you can drive to multiple other locations. We ate at Oriental it it was really good. We split and entree and appetizer and took some back to our condo.

reviews.title: GREAT TIME
reviews.text: Everything was great we really enjoyed our stay very clean, and the staff was super nice and kind. We will book here every time we come to Vegas now thank you.

reviews.title: Nice and clean!
reviews.text: The Resort is very well kept.  The Resort was very clean and the staff was helpful and accommodating.

reviews.title: Great week at The Berkley
reviews.text: Spent a wonderful week at The Berkley.  The staff was amazing, especially Irene and Alix at the front desk.  Everything was clean, the view from the room was spectacular, and it was my home away from home for a week.

reviews.title: Silverton
reviews.text: The top of the building has a large sign that reads "Silverton". which is somewhat confusing as it is the Berkley. The Silverton Casino is directly North of the Berkley. and in the same building as Cabela's which is a must-see.

reviews.title: Great rooms, helpful staff, handy location
reviews.text: Really lovely and clean rooms with great amenities and everything you could need. Lots of space, large beds, washing machine and dryer, dishwasher etc.Generously let us check in early. Easy to park and great area near to the airport and easy to access The Strip by car, as well as go for day trips out of town. The attached Silverton Casino has just been renovated and is really nice inside, with restaurants and an aquarium. Pool and gym need an update and could be bigger, but otherwise no complaints at all. Staff all helpful and friendly.

reviews.title: Perfect vacation.

reviews.title: The Berkley
reviews.text: The property by enlarge was not bad. There is a resort fee of $50 that I don't recall was made aware to me before arriving. I wish that had been clearer. I did speak with management and expressed my concern about said fees. I had never stayed at the Berkley and was truly looking forward to it. I cannot say for sure that I will want to stay again.

reviews.title: The Berkley Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great property in Las Vegas that is south of the strip but an easy drive up for events. The property is clean, parking is easy and the staff were very helpful.  Also, very easy access to the airport. We will definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Good for the cost!!
reviews.text: This is not a 5star resort, but it is good for the price. It has a great location if your driving. It is close to interstate 15 and 215 plus all stores are within a short driving distance. Easy access to a Casino, and the rooms are a nice size. Maintenance and hotel staff are very responsive. Furniture and appliances need some updating.

reviews.title: Vegas Trip
reviews.text: The room was not that clean. I washed the placemats because they were gross, there was a long black hair on the table and good in the garbage disposal. We have stayed there before and it was cleaner than this trip. A car was broken into in the parking lot. They only had 2 out of 3 elevators working on a busy weekend. It took 20 minutes to catch a ride and the service people were using the same ones with their big carts.

reviews.title: Clean, spacious and well-appointed
reviews.text: We felt very comfortable here. The suites were clean, spacious and well-appointed. It was nice to have a fully equipped kitchen with full size appliances, a nice bathroom with a soaker tub and separate shower. The entire property was very clean.

reviews.title: Fantastic location
reviews.text: Great resort, close to everything!Clean and staff is great!Room has everything you need to make a weekly stay wonderful and easy.Just steps from the Silverton Hotel, great slot play and great food selections

reviews.title: Quiet & Modern Luxury.
reviews.text: Quiet & Modern Luxury. Plenty of free parking and easy access to the highway. Friendly staff and beautiful room. This is my 2nd stay iin 6 months and beats another stay that I had at Grand View hands down.

reviews.title: Very nice for the rates!
reviews.text: The Berkeley is clean and the rooms well stocked with everything you need from cookware down to complimentary laundry soap! We will definitely return and recommend it to our friends and family!I love that all the shops and grocery stores are just a block away and we were able to go get snacks, wine and get toiletries we needed for our stay!

reviews.title: Good location for gettng around
reviews.text: Resort is close to strip but also sits on the I-15 / 215 interchange so if you want to get out and explore it is extremely easy access to every part of town.  Room was big and relatively well kept and clean for this type of property.  Lot of close restaurants, convenience stores and shopping if you need essentials.  I was there for business and pleasure and this place worked out great.

reviews.title: My Go To in Vegas Now!!!
reviews.text: This resort located at the beginning of Vegas like close to southpoint, clean , nice , excellent staff and casino not overcrowded, restaurant award winning and the strip or fremont not far away so you can still do the nightlife

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: If you want a great place off the strip the Berkley is a great value! The Condo was clean and well stock with everything you need! It is close to everything and would recommend renting a car! Thanks Berkley!

reviews.title: Best property
reviews.text: We have been coming to Vegas every year since becoming an owner at Vacation Village’s and thought this property was the best.  Have stayed at Grandview and Peace canyon and were extremely happy with those locations also, but The Berkeley was our favorite!

reviews.title: Great Location!
reviews.text: Everything about this place was excellent…Room, view, dining options at the Silverton and distance to the strip!Would recommend this for someone wanting a weekend getaway or a family vacation looking to relax poolside.

reviews.title: Great place in the LV!
reviews.text: Great location to stay away from the hustle and bustle of Las Vegas but close enough to enjoy its amenities.Thank you Berkeley for a fun and relaxing place to stay on our family trip to Las Vegas Nevada.

reviews.title: 3 night get away
reviews.text: Room was clean and spacious , but at $40-$60 each way Uber to the Strip it became a little costly. I hate the fact that each time you arrive at these places you are instantly hit with the “attending the Time Share Presentation” spiel. Nice enough place if you like quite and  don’t need to go to the Strip every day

reviews.title: Nice Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: The Berkley is 6 miles from the strip - which for us was great.  Close enough to get there for the shows but far enough to get some peaceful quiet evenings too.  The interior is a little dated but the rooms are spacious.  The w/d was helpful to have in the rooms too.  Would come to this property again in the future.

reviews.title: Feb 2024 visit to Vegas
reviews.text: This property is about 10-12 minutes off the strip and an Uber ride of less than $20. ( could add up if making multiple trips to the strip). I am picky when choosing resorts and hotels; this property exceeded our expectations. Large clean units with a window in the living room facing the mountains to the left and the strip straight ahead. The staff was extremely friendly. The Silverton facilities were in the parking lot with a casino, food court, and a Bass Pro shop. While it was too cold for the pool, it was clean. I would stay at this property again.

reviews.title: Treated poorly for checking out late
reviews.text: RCIWhen we check in, they say ‘welcome home’. We did not feel welcome at the end of our stay. We made a mistake thinking our check out time was 11, when it was in fact 10. Definitely our mistake. We were given a ‘courtesy’ extra 30 minutes. At 10:35, a security guard was sent to our room to make sure we were leaving. Not housekeeping, a SECURITY GUARD, sent there to make sure we were leaving the premises. It was extremely embarrassing as our guest was still there. I felt like I was being treated like a criminal. We were clearly trying our best to get out of there as quick as we could (front desk even called to make sure we were leaving at 10:45). I already had a big cart loaded up that the security guard could see and it did take me 2 trips. He stood there the entire time (again, like I was a criminal in trying to stay longer). My guest told him that room B was clear and ready to be attended to and he didn’t even acknowledge her speaking to him. Very odd behavior. I’ve never felt more offended at a place that I’m an owner at and have spent over $12k to ‘enjoy these services’. My wife and I will NEVER stay at the Berkeley again. We’re really considering if we want to continue being owners with this company if there are other properties that are going to treat us like this.On a side note, another thing that bothered us, is that we weren’t even allowed to have extra towels. We were told ‘this is not a hotel and you have to wash your own towels. Come down and get laundry soap’. I’ve never been told that at any of your properties and we’ve stayed at several. The fold out couch mattress was very poor as well. My guest has booked a massage for tomorrow to help with how awful her sleep was

reviews.title: Clean and quiet room
reviews.text: The room was clean and quiet.  The main problem was the power kept going off every time a hair dryer was used.  No lights would work and we had to ask for maintenance to come reset the breaker.  Finally gave up on using the hair dryer.   Location is good.  Restaurants and casinos close by.

reviews.title: My 1st time at The Berkley! Loved it!
reviews.text: This was a first time visit to the Berkley and it was an overall excellent experience. A few minor but still important points were the overly starched, rough bath towels, the internet was below standard and I was disappointed to realize there was no streaming capability when I had previously called and told there was. I'd love to stay here again and take my whole family and friends. It was nice to feel like a local but still visit all my favorite stores & restaurants.

reviews.title: Amazing stay in beautiful property minutes from the Strip
reviews.text: The Berkley, Las Vegas is a beautiful property only minutes by Uber from the Strip.  The accommodation is amazing.  It was the best property we have stayed in whilst vacationing in Las Vegas.  The washer and dryer were very handy as was the full kitchen.  The beds were very comfortable.  We would highly recommend this property to everyone.

reviews.title: Disgusting
reviews.text: Spiders in the room. Unsanitary dirty rooms. Many things are broken and not working in the room, including hot water in the shower. Staff is not friendly and not helpful. The “heated” pool is not heated. The pool is dirty, full of debris and bird feces. Not sure why a resort fee is charged for this gross place. Horrible.

reviews.title: Not new as described, outdated and needs maintenance.
reviews.text: In the RCI description it states that this is a newer resort - but it is not. It was purchased from another resort and rebranded a Vacation Village Resort.  It needs updating and some deep cleaning. Furniture and carpet is stained. Also, there are no shuttles to the strip or to downtown area.

reviews.title: The Berkley Great Christmas Stay
reviews.text: The Berkley is so nice and peaceful.  I love the Sulverton next door we had a great time with our family. We celebrated my birthday and it was also Christmas time the decorations are nice and the people are so friendly.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: This is a newer, smaller, less known resort that was a fabulous discovery. It was as close to perfect as you can get. The views are to die for, the condos seem brand new and are well designed, and it is the perfect distance from the chaos of the Strip. It is literally in the parking lot of the Silverton Casino which puts everything you need right at your doorstep, but if you want to see the rest of Vegas a car would be very helpful.

reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: Overall this was a great vacation destination.  We were able to have the grandkids and great grandkids over to swim for 3 days.  I would recommend Vacation Village to all my family and friends.  Although the toilet paper was only one ply and was used up quickly.

reviews.title: A bit far from the strip, but one of the cleanest rooms we've ever stayed in
reviews.text: Location is a bit of a stretch from the strip/Freemont or anything worth seeing in Vegas, but if you have a rental, it's not an issue - you can park at Treasure Island for free and walk around the strip.  As for the property itself, parking is free and there's a LOT of spots all around - not something that is common in LV.  It's a very quite property, very family friendly and perhaps the somewhat remote location makes up for the quiet sleep.  It is also located right next to a casino plaza with many restaurants and shops including Bass Pro with their own theme and entertainment.

reviews.title: Trip of the decade!
reviews.text: A great timeshare, very close to reasonable food and the great activities that Las Vegas offers. Great staff, top notch facilities. Near to the interstate, 15 minutes from the airport. <$20 to midtown Vegas, A nice casino across its parking lot.

reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised!
reviews.text: Whenever we travel to Las Vegas in the future, it will be here!  Perfect location, so easy to get around, incredibly relaxing!  Yet we still went to the Strip a few times (easily).  Found free parking at Tropicana and Treasure Island.  Took in a Show, NBA Tournament, FlyOver, and Fremont Street.  Thoroughly refreshed!  Ed and Suzan

reviews.title: Great location the Berkeley
reviews.text: I would recommend this place to everyone. Customer service was on point. There is an aquarium right behind the hotel and a casino. A bunch of food places with great food. So yes I would recommend the Berkeley to everyone.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: Visit to LV for a football game and a concert on the strip. We own at the Berkeley. When we purchased, our representative told us there was a shuttle service available.  When we got there , we were told there was no longer a shuttle service This was a strong selling point and we are 😞  it I no longer available.

reviews.title: Best Timeshare Ever!
reviews.text: The staff was amazing. They catered to our every want and need. The entire team was polite and courteous with a professional attitude. I do not see us staying anywhere else in the future. They are the number 1 resort for us in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Berkley 2 bedroom unit
reviews.text: This place was nice. It’s not walking distance to the strip but it was not very far away either. The place was clean and the staff was friendly. The units are a great size with 2 separate sinks in each that makes it easy for a group of girls to get ready

reviews.title: Totally Disappointed
reviews.text: Very poor experience during our last visit. As we were staying for an extended period for a special occasion I had requested a room with a pool view but what I got was a view of the parking lot for 2 weeks. When I asked could I be relocated to another room that not only had a better view but one that was quiet due to being constantly disturbed with car alarms, trash and deliveries at very early times in the morning I was told yes no problem for $75. After the amount I was paying for the stay and the bad experience the hotel staff didnt care unless I paid this fee which of course I was not prepared to do. They advised me that I should have rang to request, so what cost would that have been from the UK!! And what is the point of a messaging service.  Now to continue the waste disposal was not working on arrival with a terrible smell omitting from the sink, the microwave didn't work due to the wrong size glass plate fitted, both TV remotes were flat, the windowsill was full of dead moths so clearly had not been cleaned. Long black hairs in the vanity area and fridge! The shower area was dirty and mouldy.One elevator out of service the whole visit but not an issue as the hotel was was not busy and more of a reason why they could have moved me to a better, cleaner, functioning room, and to top it all off check out is 10am and housekeeping came to the door at 9am and asked to come in!!Totally disappointed with the whole experience

reviews.title: TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text: TERRIBLE SERVICE from the receptionist I just (Oct 29,2023 @2:00pm) went to ask someone to check my room because the door gives us strong electric shocks!! every time we tried to open it and his response was that it is normal because of the carpet!!! They didn't even try to send for maintenance.THIS HAS NEVER HAPPENED TO ME IN ANY HOTEL, I work in hospitality and IT IS NOT NORMAL!!!!

reviews.title: Quiet, Clean, Spacious and Relaxing.
reviews.text: It was our first time in Vegas and this place was awesome. I personally liked the fact that it was away from the strip about a 15 to 20 minute drive to the strip by Lyft or Uber. It was super quiet and clean. We stayed on the 18th floor in the suites with the kitchen and the washing machine and dryer. It was the perfect setup. The bed was comfortable. The room was clean and spacious and the view was amazing. There was a shopping mall area with stores for convenience right up the block all accessible by walking. Oh yes and an In and Out burger restaurant. They did not offer room service and the only real complaint we had was that a couple of the days the elevator took super long to get down to the lobby. Would not mind staying again. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Quiet
reviews.text: We have stayed here many times. It’s perfect for us. It is smaller and quiet. Not to far to walk to casino and many restaurants. Pool is smaller but perfect for us. It’s a little busy during the weekend. But during the week it is perfect.

reviews.title: A Wonderful Vacation Experience!!
reviews.text: We were off of the strip, but that was okay because we uber back and forth; and coming back to The Berkley was refreshing and relaxing from the nightlight of the strip. The suites were cozy, clean and beautifully decorated. We enjoyed the resort and plan to return!

reviews.title: Disaster at the Berkley, Las Vegas
reviews.text: Staff has no customer service etiquette. They do not care about any of your concerns. They charged housekeeping fees for services not rendered. We had to laundry our towel daily. No fresh linen or toiletries no towels for the pool. Horrible.

reviews.title: Nice place/ Bad service
reviews.text: 1st time at the Berkley Las Vegas.  Nice with large rooms.  Clean and comfortable.  A few issues with the front desk staff.  Upon arrival 4 clerks were seen but 2 were busy chatting with each other as people were standing in line to check in.  Then after we were checked in we had to go to another line and wait for a parking pass.  We asked for a luggage cart and received one with a flat tire that was impossible to push.  Later in the week we asked for 1 extra kitchen dish towel and were denied any towels.  Were told they did not have any extra towels other than the ones in the room.  A gold crown resort with RCI and not even one extra kitchen dish towel???  The staff was not helpful at all.  One package of dishwasher soap was provided.  We rented a 2 bedroom for 4 people.  We were there a week.  Staff was not friendly or helpful.  The security person was on his phone or on a smoking break most of the time.  Just not Gold Crown service I am used to.

reviews.title: Enjoyable week
reviews.text: Liked the resort as it is much smaller than others, our room was great and the location worked for us. Nice pool and hot tub and is right next door to Silverton casino as well as a nice Bass Pro store.

reviews.title: Excellent Getaway
reviews.text: This is my New best place to stay. Clean and sanitary all items. Great location and easy together any where in the valley.  Front dest was very helpful with everything we needed. We will be staying here again and again.

reviews.title: Excellent Vegas Option
reviews.text: We have travelled to Vegas many times , and this was our first off strip stay. Our accommodations were excellent; good size rooms, very comfortable and clean, well furnished with a well appointed full kitchen. Property is exceptionally maintained, and the outdoor seating area was a quiet welcome refuge at the end of the say. Being right next door to the Silverton Casino with their great selection of restaurants was an added bonus. Quick Uber ride to the strip…we never waited more than 5-10 minutes for a ride. After this stay, we have no plans to stay on the strip again.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay!
reviews.text: We were thrilled with our stay at The Berkley.  Friendly team members.  Good location.  I have one request for future guests that is a simple fix though...for the love of Pete...PLEASE put a dampener on the pool gate door.  It sounds like someone gets shot everytime it slams shut.  That is all.  Thank you!!

reviews.title: Checks all the boxes!
reviews.text: This place has everything you need for a stay in the Vegas area. Accommodations are great, location is good, on-site food and entertainment is quality, and it is quiet.  There was plenty of room for all four of us. The full kitchen was handy for prepping food when we wanted to eat in. The food at the Silverton casino restaurants was tasty. We lacked for nothing during our stay.

reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.text: Convenient location (if you would like to stay off the strip, short drive from supermarket and outlets), good parking, good size rooms, quick check in/check out. 1 out of 3 lifts was out of order during part of the stay which wasnt great. To use the luggage cart it was required to leave ID (not something I had to do before in any hotels). There is a small pool which overlooked car park and nearby casino.

reviews.title: If you want to be away from the chaos, stay here
reviews.text: Convenient location to lots of stores and chain restaurants.  Nice to be away from the chaos of the strip. Either Uber or drive to the strip. Relatively clean, amenity-filled kitchen, uncomfortable sleep sofas, only one elevator working at check out time.Note: the building says “Silverton”. Nowhere does it say “The Berkley” on the building.

reviews.title: Convenient and large unit
reviews.text: Beautiful unit and enormous for 1 bdroom. Convenient to many restaurants and stores. Easy walk but a bit dangerous if you don't cross at cross-walk. If you are looking to gamble, the casino across the way isn't great; lots of smokers and smells.

reviews.title: The Berkeley
reviews.text: This timeshare is located blocks from the stadium and close to the strip. Great purchase!! Great accommodations and great staff!! I stay here once a year and it's definitely worth the stay. And the pool is open year around.

reviews.title: Vegas holiday
reviews.text: Nice property. Freeway close making easy access to get around town. The only real issue is the property has elevator issues. I have stayed here twice in the last year and on both occasions at least one if not two of the three elevators were not operational. It’s very frustrating to only have one elevation operational for 18 floors of guests and staff.

reviews.title: Good deal
reviews.text: We are very satisfied with the location of the property and enjoyed the service. We will surely plan to return and e joy once more the fscilities. The pool area and the activities ce ter plus the gym are great addtions to the fun stay.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Wonderful updated newer rooms.  Spacious and comfortable.  No restaurant on premises but just a short walk across the back there are several different restaurants and a casino.  Just a short ride to Vegas strip with many restaurants and department stores in area of The Berkley.  Nice pool just out front door

reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: Everyone was nice and careless. The rooms are very clean. The staff was awesome. I felt safe while I was there. And even though it rained the whole time I was there I still had fun. The only thing I can take away from that is I think they need to include the entertainment there. Because when it does rain and flood like it did this past weekend. At least the guests will have some kind of entertainment that the strip have. Where if it's a club or live band. Because there's nothing that's really going on we was in bed by 9:30 in Vegas. And also I think they need a shuttle on some kind of car service to get you back and forward to the airport or something I don't know. I think that's something you need to think about. Will I go back yes I will stay again.

reviews.title: The Berkley is Great
reviews.text: We checked in very quickly. Went to our single bedroom suite and crashed.  The beds were comfortable. There were TVs in the bedroom and the living room.  Good view looking towards the South Point casino. Kitchen was well equipped. The bathroom had a nice shower and big tub. All in all it was a vert nice unit.

reviews.title: Vacation 2023
reviews.text: This property was very accommodating. When we needed a taxi, they had their own service that was very attentive.  The staff was very friendly and helpful. The rooms were spacious.  The bed was very comfortable.  The view was amazing.

reviews.title: RELAXATION WEEK
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay for a week.  Loved the room, pool and the hot tub.  Glad the casino was near so when we did not want to go to strip we did not have to go far for entertainment and food.  The majority of the staff was wonderful and very polite, however there

reviews.title: Best Vegas resort.
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort that is close to the strip but still offer privacy.  I love the fact that it sits right next to the Silverton hotel.   The resort is clean, beautiful, The pool is clean and relaxing.

reviews.title: One of my best vacation
reviews.text: I had an amazing time. The bad weather did not bother me. The staff are amazing. Casino walking distance. Lots of fun things to do walking distance if you want to drive And not drive. I wasn’t able to use the pool due to the rain and lightning. But I still had a good.

reviews.title: Great amenities for a family in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Even without being in the chaotic center of Las Vegas we decided to stay out a little and we were happy about it.The kids appreciated the swimming pool, which was easy to access and their mother was happy that there was a washing machine so they could always have everything clean

reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.text: Peaceful and quiet off strip stores around private entry, Security is a little intimidating like military, that’s not good. But the staff was willing to assist even when I lock keys in room.  Thanks for peaceful stay.

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay. I love the home away home feel. It was clean, accessible to and from the strip. My second time at this property and I will definitely be back. I love the concept of having peace and tranquilty and then when I want to venture into the madness I can. The only thing I'm hoping for, is for the shuttle service to come back.

reviews.title: A good hotel located off the Vegas Strip
reviews.text: The hotel is clean, fully equipped, cooking utensils, washing machine. Restaurants are about a 500m walk away with many crossings by car. When checking out, we do not accept luggage for guests to wait for their flight. My family had to send their belongings to another hotel. That is too bad.

reviews.title: Vegas trip
reviews.text: Overall was a good trip. We tried saving money by booking here, which was a great deal compared to strip. The only downside was the money saved from rooms was off set by transportation fees across the city.

reviews.title: Great location.
reviews.text: We have stayed here before. Love the location. Not for from all the things we were interested in doing on this vacation. Love that you are still at a resort but not right on the stripe. Still able to have some family time with children.

reviews.title: great location /reasonable prices /great rooms
reviews.text: Our stay at the Berkley was wonderful-great room with view of the strip. Rooms are clean/roomy/well supplied and great staff.   The price is very reasonable. The pool is well cared for and the pool chairs very comfortable.

reviews.title: A Wonderful Stay!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at The Berkley, Las Vegas! We had a one-bedroom unit with an awesome view of the strip. The unit was spacious and extremely clean. Parking was plentiful. We were in Las Vegas for business and drove to the strip every morning - the ride was an easy 10-15 ride. The Berkley is on the same property as the Silverton Casino which offers, in addition to gambling, some nice restaurant choices - we enjoyed the Mexican restaurant and the steak house. We were happy that we stayed at The Berkley and would stay again as well as recommend it to friends.

reviews.title: Great place to stay visiting Las Vegas
reviews.text: Very nice resort.  Well appointed.  The rooms were beautiful and comfortable.  We were next to a nice, large casino.  The restaurants were fabulous.  We had a great steak dinner one night and seafood the next.  The resort is easy to get to and there is access to all of the Vegas sites.  We had a wonderful time staying at the Berkley.

reviews.title: Leaving
reviews.text: For 160 a night it brings nothing to the plate. Nice view but to far from the strip. All restaurants in casino were closed so nowhere to eat breakfast. Nice place just is nor worth the money.  Changing hotels

reviews.title: Grossed Out
reviews.text: The good...The staff was very pleasant upon arrival, and we did not have to wait to check in, even though we arrived at noon. Refurbished rooms were decent. The bad...Most of the furniture was dusty. Stains on the walls that housekeeping should be catching. Carpet in hallways smell dirty. The pool is small for the size of the hotel. Old food up under the tv stand.The ugly......I almost broke my neck when I saw a roach run across the bedroom dresser. I've stayed in a lot of places and I must say, this was a first. I still have two nights left, and I'm already ready to go home. I'm on the 7th floor, so I can only imagine the first. Never again. It's going to be a long weekend.

reviews.title: 10/10 for The Berkley Las Vegas!!
reviews.text: The staff at The Berkley set the tone for our stay at this resort. They were all great!!! Patty, the manager, front desk Alex and Leo were extremely helpful and patient with our unique situation. I would say the entire staff are to be commended for the work that they do at this resort. Thank you to all! Highly recommend staying here.

reviews.title: The Berkeley of Las Vegas
reviews.text: Close to everything like going to the freeway, gas station, grocery stores, restaurants, Starbucks and of course the Casino. Few minutes drive to Las Vegas Blvd going to the strip. Las Vegas vacation is not complete without visiting downtown Fremont Experience.u

reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: We had a double, which is two singels with a shared entry. The room was very roomy, the bathroom and shower are great. The staff are very friendly and helpful. We have stayed at several resorts in the same area of Vegas. It's very convenient to the strip and other attractions. We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Berkley Weekend
reviews.text: Perfect conditions, we will return. Plenty to do in the general location of the resort. The rooms (2 bedroom lock off) were perfect for us. Quieter location, not right on the Vegas strip but only 10 minutes away from the lights and glamour of Vegas

reviews.title: The perfect vacation spot
reviews.text: The staff was very friendly at check in and throughout the stay. The location is close enough to the strip to partake in the nightlife, but far enough away when you need a break. The pool is huge, clean and barely ever occupied by more than a few people. They put us on the 14th floor with a beautiful view of the the Las Vegas skyline. We’re definitely coming back again in the future.

reviews.title: Pretty Good Resort
reviews.text: Clean Resort, friendly staff. Should have car to enjoy the area, Resort does not have a shuttle service to anywhere. Wish they offered shuttle service of some type. This is not a resort issue, but the Silverton is limited, as far as restaurants & entertainment. Wish there had been pool towels down at the pool & you didn’t have to bring pool towels from your room & then take wet towels back to your room.

reviews.title: Very clean resort
reviews.text: This resort was very nice and clean. The pool area was a lot smaller than expected. We were not satisfied with this resort because when we checked in, the room that they provided us with was already occupied! We really hope this is something that doesn’t happen often but we won’t be returning to this resort again!

reviews.title: Good location
reviews.text: Close to lots of dining and shopping optons and walking distance to Silverton Casino/Bass Pro Shop. Room was clean and furnishings were nice and up to date.  Room was well equipped with all necessary kitchen needs plus an in room washer and dryer..

reviews.title: Great Location for Family Vacation
