reviews.text: The Berkely Las Vegas is next to Silverton Casino and Bass Pro Shop.  It is not too far from shopping area and restaurants.  Great location for family vacation. It has swimming pool on site but swimming towels provided at swimming areas.  Towels are at your room.

reviews.title: Family friendly
reviews.text: Brought my entire family (16 of us) to stay at while we traveled to different nation parks and they felt at home and everything was conveniently around us. A lot of on-site amenities were family friendly as well as things to do for adults.

reviews.title: Loved the Berkley
reviews.text: Love the place will be coming back clean nice pool rooms are very nice would recommend it to friends  loved it , nice location lots of stores around it nice work out facility and it's very quiet not a lot of noise staff was excellent , didn't like the Silverton casino but it's very close to our fav Southpoint  which always pays well. Will be coming back here next time we come to Vegas

reviews.title: R&SM
reviews.text: The place was very clean, updated, near many eateries, 2 wonderful outlet malls and the staff was exceptional friendly. It is convenient near the airport, several great places inside  the casino behind the building.

reviews.title: Good Stay at The Berkley Las Vegas
reviews.text: Good location, and property. Will come back again. The Bass Pro Shop is near at a walking distance and also the Silverton Casino. Restaurants and shoppings around 5 to 10 minutes driving distance. I recommend.

reviews.title: Las vegas
reviews.text: Staying here is always great.  The place is in perfection location.  Close to the strip and fremont.  Silverton casino is next door so no need to venture to far out if you wanna stay in.  Will always come back here for sure.

reviews.title: Great hotel and casino
reviews.text: This hotel was great. Collocated with the casino. Was given some exceptional coupons to use for food from the casino. Variety of restaurants was excellent with great meals. Casino was a plus that was unexpected

reviews.title: Nice spot away from strip
reviews.text: A ways away from the strip. Pool is small but still nice and quiet area. Next to casino and a couple restaurants. Quick check in. Not bothered for resort tours as in some stays. Rooms we nice and in good shape

reviews.title: Not looking for a Strip Experience
reviews.text: Really enjoyable stay, the unit is spacious and nicely appointed.  Staff very friendly and accommodating, helpful with suggestions.  Everything we needed was on hand and available in unit, pool towels, extra tissue, paper towels, etc. The unit is comfortable for a couple or small family.  Nice and roomy bathroom with a separate vanity is a perfect addition to the unit.  The kitchen is well stocked with good appliances and cookware.  Ample parking and easy access to the garage or out door lot.   Driving or walking is convenient to many food places, shopping and casino.

reviews.title: Amazing resort but beware of the special lunch
reviews.text: During the check in I was told I had earned a free breakfast or lunch at a buffet at the south point casino and hotel. I was asked to pay $20 to reserve the table. Mybhusband and I were really excited. When we arrived at the wrong address it was a mission to get to the correct building. Then we found out it was a timeshare presentation. The lunch was rushed they gave us 20 min to eat and then we took 3 hours to do the presentation we ended up purchasing the timeshare but no thanks to all the miss leading information we were fgiven at check in. Everyone was so nice and the resort was amazing. It was very clean and no cigarettes smell. Recommend 100% but be careful and ask questions.

reviews.title: Great stay off the strip
reviews.text: Had a great time at this resort. Quiet enough with many amenities on site and in walking distance. Only flaw was miscommunication of the mid week tidy. It ended up being one day earlier than scheduled and expected so we had to wash our own towels throughout the week after that as we didn’t get a chance to exchange them. Very good setup and convenient location off the strip.

reviews.title: Awesome place away from the busy strip
reviews.text: The Berkeley is a great hotel away from the strip. And, Silverton being right there made the experience worthwhile. Starbucks is walking distance. Rooms were clean and the staff were nice. The only drawback was not enough shade by the pool from the scorching sun. Will definitely return

reviews.title: Worst Evil Staff Ever
reviews.text: The worst staff in the history of customer service.  The manager Asia supported calling the police and kicking out an owner (me).  Who kicks someone out for no reason and then have the audacity not to give a refund they have no class  and no ethics. The staff was clueless didn't know how to fix the computer, didn't know there was a  bbq grills, refused to all the customers to use the scanner machine and didn't know there was a scanner machine.  When I pointed out the machine they lied said it was company policy not to allow guest to use it.  You just said you didn't have one now that i point out the machine it policy not to allow customers to scan one page.  They were rude, evil, overweight, had homosexuals working the front desk.  Only clean the room once a week. Charged resort fee.  Asia the manager refused to give me upper management contact information, she and her staff member hung up the phone on me when asking how to fix the business center computer.  I would highly recommend not staying at this rude, disrespectful, evil, lazy, ignorant, and useless staff's resort.  Management and staff terrible it's as if they intentionally tried to provide poor service.  My Name is Charles Williams

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: This hotel was very clean and a great priceI would definitely stay here again just because of how nice the hotel is the one thing I did not like was that it was off the strip, but it still wasn’t too bad to get to the main part of the

reviews.title: Quiet and well maintained resort
reviews.text: It's nice to be just outside all the hustle of Vegas, but near enough to enjoy it.  The resort was very well maintained and clean.  I would recommend this facility and there is a casino on the property.

reviews.title: I’m divided
reviews.text: I want to give it more a better rating because overall it was pleasant. I just wish the first guy at the check in who couldn’t find our reservation would have tried harder instead of making us feel so embarrassed like it was our fault. But, the other guy made up for it when he finally found the reservation and everyone else was friendly and the room was nice.

reviews.title: The Berkley was the Bomb!!
reviews.text: Great place to stay and excellent location to everything. We decided to become owners at this particular property because of the location and the growth happening around it. The time we spent with Nancy, Diane and Cee was also just as rewarding. Thanks

reviews.title: Great Vacation At The Berkley!
reviews.text: Ny wife and I have stayed at both sister properties (The Cliffs at Peace Canyon and The Grandview) previously, but this was our first stay at The Berkley. We really enjoyed our stay here. The setup is similar to both sister properties, but The Berkley is the newest property of the three. We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Berkley Hotel stay
reviews.text: We enjoyed the room and the view (15th floor).  The unit was comfortable, roomy, and well appointed.  It seemed like we were the only ones there since we rarely saw other guests but the staff said they were fairly full.

reviews.title: Roomy, off-the-strip accommodations
reviews.text: We wanted a quiet place with nice accommodations and easy access to the Strip and outlying casinos, and the Berkley delivered. Nice, roomy VERY CLEAN condo, comfy beds. (Pillows were pretty lumpy tho!)  Leo at the front desk was very helpful at check-in. Pool is small but looked nice - we didn’t use it at all for this trip in January. We will definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: November Stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Very nice modern resort. The distance to the strip is a lot longer than stated on their website.  IT IS nothing  IN WALKING DISTANCE!!!!  20 minute drive. Clean pots and pans in the clean cabinets.  Extra large bathroom was very nice as well.

reviews.title: Better Choices In Vegas
reviews.text: A little out of the way,.  Need a car.  No shuttle.  Silverton is not a destination casino.  The Berkley is just a building with rooms.  I would not even call it a hotel.  It has no amenities other than a tiny pool, with no landscaping, adjacent to the parking lot.  Not very appealing.  Craker Barrel, Blaze & Starbucks within walking distance.  Bass Pro on site, has a nice aquarium.  The best thing that happened is that I discovered Dutch Bros Coffee, just up the street. (drive-thru only).

reviews.title: Wonderful Vegas visit
reviews.text: The Berkley was conveniently located.  Plenty of parking. Easy in and out.  The rooms were spacious and quite comfortable.  Nicely appointed.  Next door is the Silverton -- fine restaurants, casino and wonderful aquarium.  It was easy to travel around the city and return to this beautiful resort.  We will definitely visit here again.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: We stayed at the Berkeley for three days and it was perfect. Great, quiet location, off the strip but only $15 Uber to get there. Room was very comfortable, clean and updated. Beautiful bathtub. Friendly staff.

reviews.title: Absolutely wonderful - Can't wait to stay again!!!
reviews.text: Over the past 10 years, I've stayed at quite a few properties in the Las Vegas area, and this is my new favorite. It was a great location, wonderful layout with a nice kitchen, comfortable bed, and bathtub to die for.. There was also a beautiful view, well appointed and comfortable, and super private and quiet. There are plenty of stores and restaurants in the area, as well as the Casino if that's your thing even though its not mine. I  have no negative comments, and will be staying here again for sure.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Excellent staff and accommodations. Would definitely stay there again. Unit was clean, staff was friendly and professional. The manager, Patty, and the other staff were kind and considerate when I had a car emergency. Their efforts were very much appreciated.

reviews.title: Well equipped studio.
reviews.text: The Berkeley in Las Vegas is a block of apartments adjacent to the Silvertown casino. The block is a long way from the Strip, so you will need a car. There is a bus but it doesn’t come more than once an hour, even though they are scheduled every 30 minutes.The apartment itself is modern, clean and well laid out. There’s a comfortable queen sized bed and quality bedding and pillows. There are also 2 tv’s with a range of American only channels. The kitchen has a dishwasher, 2 x electric hob and a large fridge freezer. (Studio apartment). All cutlery, cups, plates etc are supplied and are in good condition. There’s also a free guest laundry on the 4th floor with a washing machine and a tumble dryer and a vending machine for soap powder.The reason I’m giving 4 and not 5 starts is because I specifically asked for a quiet room and one on the ground or first floor as I’m afraid of heights. I was put on the 5th floor, where there’s floor to ceiling glass and the room was the nearest to the 3 lifts that were running day and night. The room itself is soundproofed so you can’t hear your neighbours but the front door isn’t and the traffic and noise was endless. The Berkeley doesn’t have any restaurant facilities but the casino next door has a number of fast food and restaurant options and there is a garage  with a convenience store attached nearby. Just cross the 8 lane interstate at the end of the road, which has a pedestrian crossing.Would I stay here again? Probably not. It’s too far out and unless you have an apartment at the end of the corridors, the noise would be prohibitive for me.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
reviews.text: Attractive newer suites in a pretty good location- walking distance to many stores & restaurants. Right beside the Silverton Hotel/Casino with several good restaurants.Excellent outdoor heated pool but a very limited Fitness Centre. Great Staff & Service.

reviews.title: Underwhelmed
reviews.text: 1 bedroom suite was comfortable - nice to have washer/dryer, 2 tvs and a full kitchen. However, furniture was beat up, some lights didn't work, shower barely drained and housekeeping was non-existent. Hotel is far from the strip. We didn't use the pool but it was very exposed to the parking lot - it looks much more appealing online. We wouldn't return.

reviews.title: Pleased again
reviews.text: Love this place every time we stay here. Very clean, great location, great views and the friendliest staff.  Within walking distance across the parking lot to the Silverton Casino and close to a few restaurants. We look forward meeting up with Eugene or Dennis in the building as they are both so friendly and genuine on asking how our stay is. We’ll look forward to coming back.

reviews.title: Very nice place - highly recommend
reviews.text: This is a great property just off the strip to the south with a casino adjacent.  It is clean with friendly staff and all the needed amenities.  I love the off strip location and the Cabela's that is on property.  Nice pool and they promptly take care of all needs.

reviews.title: Relax in Vegas
reviews.text: We have traded out Mexican timeshare for the last few years , we have traded to the Berkeley and Tahiti village. For us the Berkeley fits best. We are older and like the peace and quiet, the pool is smaller but perfect for us. The casino in close walking distance is great. The restaurants in the casino are good. Tahiti village is better for families, the pool is awesome and has a lazy river. But you need transportation to do anything.

reviews.title: Family Time
reviews.text: We usually stay at this resort, but it seems like some things need to be updated.  A few complaints during my stay is the drawer that we had on our bedroom, kept opening and sand did not want to close should be replaced.  Also, during this stay the pillows for anyone staying on sofa bed were too small. Other than that, we usually have a great experience the each time we stayed, and still love the resort, but maybe need to reserve

reviews.title: Relaxing Vegas
reviews.text: The Berkerley is one of the newer properties with very good sound insulation.  We did not hear adjacent units nor airplanes.  Very generous with detergents, coffee, paper towels.  The unit was cleaned more than once.

reviews.title: Great option for families
reviews.text: The Berkley was a great fit for our family trip, 2 1bdrm units side by side. Decor and furnishings were in good condition. 2 washers and 2 dryers helped out. Close to 99cent store and gas station is conveniently near by, entrance/exit to freeways easily accessible including the Las Vegas strip and nearby Mall. Staff was great, a bit on the quiet side, not much to do at the pool. No room jacuzzi like our home resort offers. Love the drive up area in the back and easy access to elevator to get unloaded from your car to the room and settle in. Overall a great choice to stay with family and if you don't want to be in a casino. Silverton Casino is a quick 2-5 min walk. Not much luck there at the casino. Bass Pro shop is in the same lot. Great views

reviews.title: Relaxing stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Used to stay at Grand View this is 100% improvement on it. Easy accessible to the strip using uber. Clean and quiet. Pool never too busy. Would recommend to friends. Just don't try to use the elevators if you are in a rush around 10 - 10.30ish on a Monday it's check out time and we waited on the 15th floor for 6 minutes!

reviews.title: Fall week in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We spent a week at the Berkeley, the units are appropriately sized for a couple with a full kitchen. 10 - 15 min from the Strip, the new football stadium, airport and most major venues. The Silverton is a short walk from the lobby and staff was very good. The Berkeley is a great off the strip stay for those who do not need all lights and glitter of the strip every second every day.

reviews.title: Excellent Las Vegas stay
reviews.text: The check-in process was super fast and - best of all  - no high pressure tactics to sit through a timeshare presentation!   Units were clean and well appointed.   Pool was nice with plenty of seating.  Exercise gym was adequate for travel needs.

reviews.title: Always a great stay
reviews.text: We have stayed here several times in the past 2 years and will continue to return.  The room is clean and spacious.  Staff are very friendly and helpful.  It’s located just steps from the Silverton Hotel, which is the reason we stay here.  The only mild negative is the elevator seems slow and definitely avoid it during check out times; this was because one of the elevators was out of service.

reviews.title: Berkley Las Vegas.
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean , spacious rooms. Beautiful grounds, located across the driveway from Silverton Casino and just a few minutes from the main strip. Great location. If your room faces the North, great view of the strip. Easy to get to when you travel around Vegas. The pool isn't too exciting. No food or beverages available at resort, only vending machines.

reviews.title: Great view
reviews.text: Good location although not on strip.  Handy access to I-15.  Casino on sight with Bass Pro and Cracker Barrel.  Handy to Strip.  Berkeley is like new building and what you would expect for Vegas.Casino has a number of various brands of restaurants.  I don’t recommend any except the Chineseit was good food and large portions.

reviews.title: Needs improvement!
reviews.text: Only 2 of 3 elevators worked to accommodate 17 floors! Ice maker in freezer never worked. Only ice machine is on the 1st floor. (We were on the 16th floor and ice was melting by the time my husband got an elevator to come back up!) Uncomfortable living area furniture.

reviews.title: Availability
reviews.text: We were very disappointed this year because although we got our allotted points for this year we did not even have enough points to stay at our home resort the Grandview. We have been owners since 2012 and go approximately the same time every year and this was a first for us.

reviews.title: very  nice
reviews.text: We loved our stay at The Berkley.  Our two connected suites were roomy, comfortable and had a great view of the city and the mountain range.  The only downside was that the pool was small and the gym needed more equipment.

reviews.title: Fun Fun Fun
reviews.text: Resort is very Nice and Quiet. Only wish there was Ventiliation in the Bathroom. The Towels pattern is rough to the touch. The location is Great right next  to Silverton Casino. The pool is small for the size of the resort.

reviews.title: Home away from home.
reviews.text: If you are looking for a place to stay in Vegas and like ample free parking, a spacious bedroom, living room, and full kitchen with washer and dryer, a one time resort fee and adjacent to a Casino (Silverton) with great restaurants and gaming, this is the place to stay.

reviews.title: The Best for me and Kids loved it!!
reviews.text: It was a very good experience . we are already looking for ward to out next vacation . Upon  arrival , They spent very little time checking us in to our rooms.  The only hiccup was having to replace key cards because the first once did not work. All the same , the rooms were very clean  , enjoyed the view  and was an excellent environment for my family.

reviews.title: The entire front desk staff needs customer service training
reviews.text: This was the worst customer service that I have ever experienced at a resort. One of the selling points at the optional timeshare presentation was the complimentary airport and area shuttle. I asked two different front desk employees about the shuttles and they both acted like they had never even heard of a shuttle. We primarily chose this resort because of the shuttle so it was ver disappointing to have to spend hundreds of additional dollars on transportation. The front desk staff was rude and unaccommodating.

reviews.title: Property is great, check-in not good
reviews.text: The rooms are fantastic for size, decor and comfort. Biggest issue was the check-in guy basically tried to talk us out of having daily room service (towels, bed make up, etc.) by painting a dire picture of the hotel FOGGING the entire room for COVID each time. Well it worked. We turned down the service since my wife has allergies. Then we found out that we couldn't get towels exchanged (sorry sir, only provided with full service). Ridiculous. The hotel was just trying to scare us so they could cut costs by not doing any room cleaning period. On a minor note, there aren't enough dishes and glasses for 2 people, let alone the 4 that our unit could sleep.

reviews.title: Beautiful Resort off the Strip
reviews.text: Resort is slightly off the strip and close to Silvertone Casino.  The resort was in a very scenic location surrounded by hills all around.  The view form the bedroom in the morning was very nice.  The resort had everything you need to make your stay comfortable.  There was minimal room service available every day.  Normally, you get them once a week.  So that was was a nice benefit.  The staff were providing any supplies we needed with a smile (washing machine soap, dishwashing hand soap, coffee pods, etc.) .  The parking was free.  There was a swimming pool and Hot tub available.  We did not use it but looked clean and not too full.  Las Vegas was hot (close to 40 C), but the Air Conditioning in the room were working well and kept the rooms cool.  Overall, we had a nice stay.  Will recommend it as a nice resort for all ages.

reviews.title: Nice property. Management was a nightmare.
reviews.text: Property is updated and comes with a lot of amenities. Had an issue with someone walking into my room. Manager Patricia, was extremely rude. I understand people may not like their job but we should not have been treated this way when we were completely caught of guard by a stranger walking in my room while i was getting out of the shower. She was completely dismissive, had an attitude and simply did not care. She made it seem like we were asking for too much to have our keys remade. Wont stay here again. Went on a tour and were going to purchase timeshare but wont pay this property my money to be treated this way.

reviews.title: Nice Stay at The Berkley, Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Berkley was very clean, the staff had a great attitude and it was conveniently located near several eateries as well as a Target store.  Excellent location for a quiet getaway relaxing by the pool or trying your gaming without having to go to the Las Vegas Strip.

reviews.title: Came here because of points, definitely would NOT pay money for this place.
reviews.text: Picked it as it was rated 4.4 stars on RCI website. First 24 hours in Vegas we immediately felt it was worth 1.5 at best. It is away from all activities and good locations in Vegas, we did not get the free airport shuttle from the hotel because we stayed at the "vacation village" portion not the "hotel and casino" portion.- Kitchen sink smelled like a sewer for the first few minutes of its use, which thankfully went away (and we didn't get sick so I guess this was just a fluke situation and not a health concern)- Shower only had scalding hot or freezing cold - there was no in between- Ice maker in freezer did not work- No service elevators for staff, so they all had to use the guest elevators, which left them crowded all the time- Only 1 of 3 elevators worked our entire trip, so we waited over 30 minutes for one to stop at the 14th floor for us several times before just giving up and taking the stairs.- Bed was not the greatest, but I guess it works for a short trip - if you stay longer than 4 days then you may end up with back problems.

reviews.title: Spacious 1 bed suite
reviews.text: Excellent base for exploring- loved the Silverton Casino being right on the doorstep. The Berkley is a  lovely property with a great pool & offers peace & quiet from the madness of Vegas.  It was great to have fridge so we ubered to Walmart & stocked up.

reviews.title: Good structure, size and clean.
reviews.text: Beside the distances from strip the hotel offers a very good structure, the rooms are very clean with a good space. Until know this was the best cost and benefits in Vegas for us.The Silverton cassino is also a good option.

reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text: We traded into this resort. Stayed a full week. Staff was very friendly. Room was very clean. Everything we needed was included.  Cracker Barrel is walking distance.  Silverton Casino is next door and many dining options there as well.  Kitchen well stocked and we used it for breakfasts and many dinners too.  10 minutes to the strip.  Ample free parking.

reviews.title: Nice off-the-strip place to stay
reviews.text: The one-bedroom layout was great- full kitchen; bathroom area with a large shower, tub, two sinks, and stackable washer/dryer;  sizable bedroom, and sizable living area.  One thing to note:  A two-bedroom is actually two one-bedroom units.  There is one hallway door that gives access to two units (Example: 1100A & 1100B).  So, for the most part, you need to go through two doors to get into your one-bedroom unit.  There is a pool area (pool & spa) and a gym, as well. The Berkeley is next to the Silverton, but the building says Silverton on the top.  There are restaurants in the Silverton and a Cracker Barrel nearby, as well.

reviews.title: Nice off the strip resort
reviews.text: Nice, clean units.  Nice, warm, quiet pool if relaxation is what you’re looking for.  Convenient location to grocery and shops.  Good size unit with extremely comfortable beds.  Daily towels replaced if you wish. Well kept, clean buildiing, pool area, and grounds.  Seems like a very safe resort.

reviews.title: Been here, done it and will do it again!
reviews.text: We really like the Berkley, it's location and easy access to all our needs: restaurants, shopping, highways.  The Berkley is clean and attractive, comfortable and quiet.  It is our preferred location off strip.

reviews.title: Great place to stay in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: This resport was a really nice place to stay. The unit was roomy and had all the amenities. It was close to the Las Vegas strip (driving) and was quiet. There was a casino there as well. We would definately stay there again!

reviews.title: NICE HOTEL/ NOT RESORT
reviews.text: Very clean and nice unit. This is a nice hotel but NOT A RESORT!  One vending machine and one ice machine on the first floor, and the pool is out front in the parking lot. Not a single amenity to call this a resort.Staff was all very friendly.Fine place to stay if you are doing other things and want a clean nice place to sleep but if you are planning on staying and relaxing at a resort not your place.  Best there is a small casino next door.No idea what gives this place a gold crown from RCI.

reviews.title: Nice hotel, poor service
reviews.text: Pros:  nice quiet location off the strip, lots of stores nearby, well kept propertyCons: maintenance issues first room had a leaking sprinkler head over the TV we were then moved to another room and the kitchen sink drain was clogged which required three visits from maintenance to finally correct by snaking the drain, requested additional pillows upon check in on Saturday but we were told housekeeping was only available from 8 to 4 and to leave a note to them in our room after several requests we received the pillows on Thursday, the web site for the hotel was not updated to reflect that shuttles to the strip have been discontinued and that grills are no longer availableOverall while not the worst experience we were disappointed in the property and will not return

reviews.title: Nice Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: My family and I spent some time vacationing in Vegas.  The Berkley's location is ideal, it is right off of I-15 / I-215.  We were not in Vegas for the Strip and casinos, so The Berkley provided a nice place to stay.  The staffs were very professional and helpful.  Resort is new and modern and very clean.  The view from our room was awesome.  Check-in and check-out were a breeze.  There are plenty of space for parking.  Silverton Casino and Bass Pro Shops are right next door.  There are many many restaurants, shops, and stores along Blue Diamond Road.  It was also an easy drive (< 10 min) to hit all the restaurants and shops along Rainbow Blvd.   Red Rock Canyon is right down the road via Blue Diamond Road.  The airport is < 10 min away.  You can go to Henderson, The Strip, or Summerlin all within 15 min drive.  We enjoying staying at The Berkley while in Vegas.

reviews.title: Nice but Disappointed
reviews.text: I am an owner through RCI at The Berkley. Imagine my surprise when I got treated just like jo schmo who booked their room through Travelocity or whoever. The grills did not work and we found that out only when we wanted to use them so I had to cook hamburgers in my condo. Our whole condo smelled like hamburgers all week. When we checked in we had one simple request, that we be put in the same room number sides a and b with my brother in law and sister in law. We both called multiple times before we traveled and then asked when we got there and guess what apparently it was impossible to accommodate. I find this funny as the girl at the front desk told me if we would have arrived the same day they would have put us together. I will say the resort itself was nice. We love the location and the view from the condo. Silverton casino is right next door and has great restaurants and was not as crowded as the casinos on the strip.

reviews.title: Berkley overall great a few small things need adjusting.
reviews.text: Resort is about 12 minutes away from the strip and costs about 15-20 bucks each way by Uber -we thought it was closer. Units are fantastic and new! Pool and whirlpool are excellent but there needed to be more pool furniture for people to sit by the pool. They turned off all of the ice makers in every unit so it was super inconvenient to go to the only ice maker on the ground floor to get ice-irritating. On top of that the beverage machine was broken for the entire 11 days we were there. There are a few shops close to resort including Bass Pro Shop but for the most part you need a car or Uber to get everywhere.The resort is located right next to Silverton Casino which has a few restaurants and a Starbucks but to get to a grocery store or Target you will need a car.

reviews.title: Modern and clean
reviews.text: This was my second stay at this resort.   It was just as clean and nice this stay as it was on my first.  On site casino was ok but this resort is not near the strip so a car is needed.  We always rent a car in Vegas so we were fine with it.  In fact, I kind of like the slower pace vs. the crazy crowds downtown or on the strip.   You can drive the strip in 10 minutes or down town in 15 minutes.   I had some problems with coffee maker but staff resolved on the 2nd attempt.   Cablevision has a good selection but it went out in the whole building one night for several hours.   I will return again.

reviews.title: Rigid Front Desk Policies
reviews.text: I traded for 2 Units at this property because of a Trade Show nearby. One unit was for my daugh0ter and the other for an employee. My employee was allowed to take his family with him. I paid for a Guest Certificate in his name, Due to an airline problem, his arrival was delayed until 11PM. His wife's mother and sister arrived in mid-afternoon. He called the resort to give permission for them to enter the unit without having to wait 8 hours for his arrival. They front desk refused to allow it. He called me and I called the front desk and was told to call RCI, but it\ closed early on Sunday. I went online to RCI, but no latye changes were allowed by their computer system. I called again and got a very unsympathetic response. Requiring a 70 year old woman to wait until midnight was both unnecessary and inhumane.

reviews.title: GREAT place for a getaway
reviews.text: Traveled to LV for an extended weekend.  The Berkley was a nice place to re-energize.  Was a little too far from The Strip for my liking but we made it work.  The area around us had some good food and a nice casino.  Would stay there again.

reviews.title: Nice Off Strip Location
reviews.text: We really enjoyed this place.  It is next to the Silverton casino, which has amazing restaurants.  The Berkley suites are very nice, we put our daughter and her partner here and they were very comfortable.  Nice tub, shower, kitchen was well appointed, and they enjoyed the comfy king bed.The Sundance Grill had the best breakfast we had the entire time we were in Las Vegas, and a great price.  We also loved the Mexican restaurant, Mi Casa Grill.  Excellent food and the Cadillac margarita pitcher at $28 was the best drink deal by FAR.  Great service at every meal.The aquarium and nature preserve were awesome.  The mermaid lounge was awesome.  Loved them all!Best thing of all was that there are no resort fees… just one $25 charge for the stay.  We saved about $250 just on that one item.  We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Not sure who they are paying to try to negate all the poor reviews but do yourself a favor and read them for details - I should have.Like others, I was initially impressed with the facility, it's a nicer timeshare hotel with full kitchens. Unfortunately there were too many problems and the staff is terrible which makes it as bad or worse as other properties.Had to contact them three times (not counting initially being charged 3x for the resort fee):-First time - asked for no maid service that day but could we have some new towels. Was told "if you refuse maid service you refuse it all" but they would see what they can do (huh?)-Second time (after letting them service the room the prev day) - told them we didn't need it that day, but that the maid didn't replace the tp. Was told I could come get some myself at the front desk.(wow)-Third time - called to ask why the maid was knocking at our door at 830a? They said "did you signup for maid service?" I said sure, which you said was from 10a-4p? She said she would have to call back. Called back to tell me they made a "mistake" (that woke my whole family) and meant the room next to us (A suite). I asked why they would be servicing the room this early right next to us? They said because it was vacant.The staff was argumentative, unapologetic and unhelpful. On top of that, as others have stated, beds were terribly uncomfortable and the jack and jill connection to the one bathroom was a hindrance and not a help. A couple of the electrical outlets didn't work and they have a ton of unintentional nightlights in the rooms. The fridge icemaker didn't work and there was no ice bucket for the one machine in the lobby.  They also only have one little pool for over 200 rooms.

reviews.title: Great but beware if you need decent internet
reviews.text: The staff was very friendly and the rooms were well furnished and clean. However my wife and I both do remote work, at least some of the time, and the internet was so terrible we ended up leaving a day early and checking into another hotel so that we could have decent internet to "work from home."

reviews.title: Nice Layout
reviews.text: While off the beaten track, "i.e., strip" a bit, The Berkley is very nice.  In close proximity to a large Casino complex with a number of restaurants, it works out great. Easy freeway access makes it convenient for trips out or in to town.

reviews.title: Trying to Rip Us Off
reviews.text: This place was honestly very nice when you first walk in. Huge suites, literal full kitchens, nice-ish view. But that's were it ends. This could have been a 4 star review, we liked it there despite the flaws and were being very nice and forgiving. BUT they are ignoring us.We staying in room 1005A/B from the 24th to the 28th and here were the issues in increasing order:- Beds and pull out couches weren't comfy, but you kinda expect pull outs to be bad and my back requires firm mattresses so I will leave this as the least of all things.- The lock on the main door doesn't exist, they told us it's cause the 2 doors to the A and B suites do and sometimes they are booked separate so that's where you lock. I understand the logic I guess.- The sliding door to the bathroom from the bedroom side on side B (the right side if I am incorrect in which was A or B) was slightly misaligned and made it very difficult to lock the door so our roommates wouldn't accidentally walk in on you using the facilities.- The main door to the bathroom from the kitchen side on side A (or left) didn't have a lock period. It didn't exist. Basically everyone on that side had to announce their intention to use the bathroom so no one came in on accident.- Coffee wasn't replaced, and towels and A side weren't replaced as often as ours's on B side. This prompted the person who booked the room to go downstairs and politely ask for some coffee and also to bring up all these other issues since we were enjoying ourselves and these weren't deal breakers for now. She also brought up this last issue while there which is the most egregious.- BROKEN TV FROM DAY ONE THEY ARE CHARGING US FOR DESPITE PROOF. The TV in side A was broken. I don't not know how, but it broken the second we turned it on. But the TV on B side worked so we didn't care, we just all used B to hang out as the larger group. We just TOOK A PICTURE and told them about it... TWICE. I was the one who gave the front desk my ID in order to borrow a trolley for our bags during check in. When I brought it back down to get my ID back, I told them that the TV was broken and didn't want them to charge us since we found it that way. The lady said was incredibly apologetic and wanted to get a maintenance crew up right away. I said we will be gone in the city by noon the next day (the 25th) and they can do it then. The TV was STILL broken upon our return after the convention we came to town to go to. We didn't care in the moment. On the 27th the person who booked the room went to get the coffee and tell about these issues like I already said and mentioned the TV AGAIN. Now here's where they get a ONE STAR REVIEW: THEY ARE ATTEMPTING TO CHARGE US FOR THE TV AND WILL NOT ACCEPT OUR PHOTO PROOF! They said they only have the report from the 27th the day before we checked out and NOT from the 24th the day we checked in! I was the one who did it on the 24th! ME! And more so we have literal proof, we took a photo, it's time stamped in the meta data showing it was like that since we moved in! And yet they refuse and want to charge us anyway. We were willing to forgive so much of these small but very annoying issues cause the room was "nice" and we had fun, but now I feel like if this is how we are getting treated that maybe if we pay that much then we shouldn't of had those tiny issues in the first place either! Zero out of ten!Guarantee we are disputing those charges, if you wanna deny reality cause you can rip us off, then suffer. The staff was nice, the management were awful. No photo here cause it was my friend and the reservation owner who took them... but it wouldn't matter cause you probably wouldn't accept it here either.

reviews.title: Great location.  Close but not too close to the Strip.
reviews.text: Great parking. I really like the smaller size of this resort.  Close to Silverton Casino and close to the Strip.  Unit was quite nice and very comfortable.  I will definitely stay here again in the future.

reviews.title: Classy name for a classy resort
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Berkley.  The atmosphere of the resort, the staff, the exterior and the surroundings in the areas made my visit sooo pleasant.  Our unit was bright, the king size bed was comfortable in fact the entire decor of the unit was comfortable.  I give this The Berkley 5+ star. I am an avid traveler and have stayed at many resorts.  I know quality when I am in it.

reviews.title: Awesome view!!!
reviews.text: Clean, unit was current wasn't outdated looking didnt have a 80's-90's feel to it thank goodness. Great staff all around. Convenient to a lot! Only issue was carpet always shocked us in touching the handles to each door. The water oressure in shower was extemely low but the were able to fix after.

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: We decided to try The Berkley as our resort for this trip to Las Vegas. We were extremely disappointed from the front desk staff to the size of the unit. The units are very small. When it came time to exchange our towels for fresh ones, we were told that we had to sign up for full housekkeeping duties or we couldn't get the clean towels?! The staff in my opinion, was extremely rude when I tried to explain that all I wanted was clean towels.Also when we went to launder some close we found that we were only given enough detergent for 1 load. We will NOT stay at this resort again!

reviews.title: A Covid week in Vegad
reviews.text: A nice accommodation off the strip in Las Vegas.  Easy access to I-15 and 415 to get to all areas of Vegas.  Bass Pro Shop on site.  Spacious accommodation with full kitchen (well supplied).  Even a powder / make up area with separate sink.  We enjoyed our stay. It was Covid times - keeping to CDC requirements at resort was a positive.  Timing did not allow us to take full advantage of the amenities - pool, hot tub, gym, and casino (next door).  We will return in non Covid times for the full experience.

reviews.title: A very nice & new resort
reviews.text: Well maintained & new resort; excellently located next to I-15 and near walking to shops but signage is poorly labeled where to go to unload and park because it is where Silverton Casino is co-located.

reviews.title: Unknow Las Vegas treasure
reviews.text: Berkley is lovely property with great views Of the Las Vegas surrounding area.  It is conveniently located near freeway entrance.  Conveniently located very near huge Bass Pro Shop and large casino.Once you park you can walk to everything.

reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: Room not cleaned as stated for covid cleaness as stated.   Washer leaked twice to no avail. Too many poi ts used for equality of room.the toiletries were in a plastic bag left on the kit hen counter and not put in pla e by room service. When i asked for the room to be cleaned it was done poorly....?..

reviews.title: Love this unit
reviews.text: Love the size of this unit and its proximity to the Silverton Casino. The Casino has many nice restaurants with really good food within walking distance of the unit. This is one of our favorite spots in Las Vegas. Away from the crazy strip. The only downside is the incessant music in the parking lot. I really don't need that all hours of the day and night. Other than that pretty perfect. And they do charge a resort fee (so what else is new), but $25 for the week, not a daily fee.

reviews.title: A restin place!
reviews.text: 11/25/21. After 3 weeks in Hawaii, I want to slow down before heading home to New York! This was my first time at the Berkley, I was pleasently surprise, it was well appointed, loved the BIG tub! there is no fresh air, recirculated air was dry! tempeture control was adjustable and  on point pool, jucuzzi and excercise room was great! NO ONE used them, I had them all to myself!! DELIGHTFUL!  The Diamond mall is a block away and Smith supermarket is a mile away! Silverton Casino is in the back yard! Lyst seems to be the car servive of choice.

reviews.title: Nice to have an apartment instead of a hotel
reviews.text: Because we had a car and have been to Las Vegas many times, staying in a apartment off the strip was what I searched for online. The Berkley was perfect for us. Complete kitchen, dining area, living room with comfortable couches, very large bathroom with walk-in shower and oversized tub, separate area with sink and makeup table and bench. We stayed 4 nights and it was honestly the best sleep I’ve had in ages. Super comfy king sized bed, lots of pillows, extremely quiet. We were on the second floor overlooking the pool and hot tub area. The Berkley and Silverton Casino are part of the same property. There’s tons of free parking all around the resort (but no resort fees), nice grassy areas with fire pits, Adirondack chairs to lounge on, a few restaurants in the casino. Because the Berkley is far south of the strip you do need a car or taxi to get anywhere. There are plenty of restaurants, grocery stores, gas stations, etc, across Blue Diamond Road but it’s a hefty walk. The odd things were - you had to agree to housekeeping during your stay but every day you have to call and request no service. During COVID, I don’t want strangers in my room. If you don’t agree when you check in, then you cannot get fresh towels or whatever. There’s a washer and dryer in the 1 bedroom apartments. They leave 1 box of laundry soap for 1 small load but if you want more you have to buy it from the vending machine. They do not offer late checkout. They will allow you an extra half hour but that’s 10:30 AM. Doesn’t help if you have a late flight. I had booked a 2 bedroom suite but it turned out to be 2 one bedroom apartments, mirror images of each other. Walk in your door from the hallway, then there are apartment A and B doors. Not adjoining. Not a big deal, just odd. Regardless, we loved our stay at the Berkley and will definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Spacious
reviews.text: New, clean and spacious units.  Would have given a 5 star but pool was too cold to enjoy.  Stayed for a week but they never attempted to increase the temperature after numerous guests complained.  Flexible room cleaning available, didn’t need daily housekeeping service and preferred not having them come every day.

reviews.title: Ed Wisdom  a one time guest
reviews.text: This review is the direct result of the lack of care, concern and compassion  I received by the manager "Kristen" at the Berkley.  Despite having the ability to help. Her refusal spoke volumes. Our flight was canceled and delayed by 8 hours. We reserved the room for ourselves and another couple, the room was in our name.  The couple was not allowed to check in.  I contacted the manager explained the Situation  and she could have cared less that our friends will be on vacation  holding and carrying their suitcase for 8 hours...... you see they would not allow me to check in over the phone or anything.  Because they couldn't verify it was me......seriously, who knew there were phone bandits who had been hijacking rooms or had called ahead to inform of a situation.  I had offered to video call, zoom, fax, etc.  She claimed she did not have that technology available.   We weren't asking for anything more than for them to place their suitcase in the room.  Now they sId the only way they would change it was if our booking agency authorized the change...well guess what they said they authorize the other couple to check in however that wasn't good enough for the manager Kristen. It sucks that I'm already dreading going to the Berkley.  This will be my first and last visit to Berkley based on the lack of human care and concern, their obvious lack of passion for their guest or future guests speaks volumes.

reviews.title: Berkley Resort
reviews.text: good location, easy access to any area in Vegas.  Nice view of the strip and nice pool.  Gym was small but all new, modern equipment. Staff not always helpful. Room was very nice, most of furniture was ok. some was old.

reviews.title: Nice units and away from the crowds
reviews.text: Unit was GREAT and I liked the location. The building is a little away from all the strip action, which I enjoy. The Silverton was a GREAT casino to play in and the food credits were fantastic. I was very surprised at the quality of the food at the eateries in the casino. The staff of the Barkley could be a bit nicer and learn to smile a bit more, maybe act like they are happy that you came to their resort, instead of quoting company policies for the silliest things.

reviews.title: Boring Timeshare.
reviews.text: Absolutely no activities,  nothing to do. The Silverton Casino is old and smells awful.  Walking distance to a store is about half a mile or more. They do not keep up with making sure the vending machines are filled. We had ran out of water, no water in the vending machines, the front office would not give us water.

reviews.title: Enjoyment
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Beautiful Berkeley. This was the best vacation ever. The room was beautiful amazingly clean and spacious. The bed and pillows were so comfortable I didn’t want to leave my room. When you are in Vegas there’s no time to sleep. The staff made my stay extremely welcoming and treated us like family. I look forward to my next trip soon. I would definitely recommend anyone who’s look for a great location and fun atmosphere to stay at Las Vegas Berkeley.

reviews.title: Feedback on Vacation Village at Berkley
reviews.text: Ice makers in both rooms did not work the entire week.  Drawers in bedroom dresser opened on their own. Leg was broke on right rear of dresser as you faced it.  Cleaning staff was excellent; new towels every day. Great location; close to Target, and Silverton was next door.

reviews.title: unhappy with cleaning
reviews.text: If you don't mind sharing blankets with previous guests then this the place for you ,housekeeping make sure you have clean door handles but if it's not visible to thee eye put that blanket back on the bed

reviews.title: Peaceful Resort.
reviews.text: Berkley Resort is a very peaceful resort. We stayed here for 3 days. From Berkley Resort we can go to any other place casinos nearby The resort is very clean, front desk is friendly, . Especially the parking space. I don’t have to drive around to looking for parking space like other resort . The room is beautiful, big, clean, and nice view…From my room I can enjoy the whole view of the strip’s lights at night.Cross street is Silverton casino you don’t have to walk far to gamble…My wife and I really enjoyed and had a very good time at this Berkley Resort. I would like to recommend to all Resort owners.

reviews.title: Home away from Home
reviews.text: I look forward to my getaways every year, and this place is all I need to be comfortable.It is truly a home away from home. Everything I needed was there. It is spacious, clean and quiet.The staff is very helpful.

reviews.title: Wasn't that impressed
reviews.text: Of all the vacation village resorts we have been to this one ranks the lowest.  No bottled water available on site the whole time we were there (with temperatures over 100 degrees outside).  Vending machines  not working and the casino next door was out also out.  Staff not always very friendly or helpful.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: The staff was great, and the room was clean. The only downside was that the jacuzzi was down for safety reasons. Its located about 4-6 miles outside of the strip, so not so busy. Because its not on the strip parking is great and its next to the highway so easy on and off to wherever you need to go. The location is just perfect if you have a vehicle. There's gas stations and a grocery store literally down the street. Great view of the mountains, it was just a great stay.

reviews.title: Great Choice will stay there again!!!!
reviews.text: The Berkeley  Resort  had a great location for all the destinations we attended. And the Casino was an added plus, that had great  restaurants. Will go there again.The staff gave extra, in assisting with app applications . And all inquiries.

reviews.title: Excellent stay, relaxing...
reviews.text: I reviewed it as excellent simply because the Berkley was away from the hustle and bustle of the strip. Only a short drive from the Berkley to the Strip by uber.  Also dining was across the street at the Silverton.  But a shuttle to and from the hotel would have been nice, also a convenience store close by instead of all the way to the nearest gas station would have been convenient. Overall, it was still excellent. Front office staff ( I forgot the name of the agent) was excellent, thorough, and friendly.

reviews.title: Nice location, clean but public area smells
reviews.text: Pros: clean, large rooms, nice bathroom, staff are professional/helpful, easy to locate, around good dining.Cons: small crowded pool, not so great crowds stay here, public areas especially elevator/hallways reek of marijuana smell. It's a nice hotel but definitely will choose another hotel since the smell of marijuana was a major turn-down.

reviews.title: Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: We had a Great time ,the staff was very helpful clean. ,We made the mistake and came to Vegas one day early thinking our vacation started on Saturday, The staff helped us find a place to stay that night and we were very thankful.

reviews.title: Third visit in the last eight months
reviews.text: My wife and I have spent over 4 weeks at the Berkley since October 2020, so we really enjoy staying there. It's close to the strip, but not walking close, but away from the traffic & noise of the strip.

reviews.title: Beautiful View and Convenient Location
reviews.text: We loved our stay at the Berkeley! The resort is conveniently located near lots of shops, restaurants and has a beautiful view overlooking the mountains (maybe 10-15 from the strip). Our unit was very spacious, had all updated appliances and exceeded our expectations for a memorable stay! The staff was very friendly and were accommodating with any requests and made us feel that our health safety and enjoyment was top priority.

reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.text: The Berkleys is a great place to visit,  perfect location with all your needs, didn't miss going to the strip.  Berkley has a wonderful staff, professional, helpful,  courteous and kind. Grounds are beautiful and clean at all times.We were on the 12th floor and had a spectacular view.   Keep up the good work, will be back in September!

reviews.title: Kudos to the Berkley Staff
reviews.text: Great service attitude of the staff. They were always cheerful and very helpful. The rooms are large and very comfortable. The bathroom is spacious, with a large tub and separate shower. This is a great location that allows me to stay away from the hustle and bustle of the Strip.

reviews.title: Berkley is the best
reviews.text: The staff from Zach the security to the ladies at the front desk to the gentleman who opened the elevator for us were awesome. They were courteous and kind. They cared. They made us feel like we were family.

reviews.title: Very Nice Property
reviews.text: The Berkley is location on the same property as the Silverton Casino. There is gaming, dining and shopping at Bass Pro Shops all in walking distance. There is also a Cracker Barrel restaurant nearby without leaving the facility. Other Shopping and dining are nearby as well.

reviews.title: away from the strip, but still very nice
reviews.text: We stayed in a 1 bdr unit through RCI exchange.  The unit was nice and roomy with a full kitchen and its own washer and dryer.  The decor was updated and tasteful, clean and well maintained.The Berkley is right across from the Silverton Casino which is nice if you are looking for some tables with lower minimum bets.  For those outdoor enthusiasts, the Bass Pro shop is attached to the Silverton Casino and shares a parking lot with The Berkley.  You will need to drive if you want to go to the LV Strip, but there are some nice restaurants near by.Keep in mind that right now, d/t COVID the hot tub is closed and their is no access to ice in the hotel (either through your own freezer or hotel ice machines), so if you want to make some blended/mixed drinks in your unite, you will need to buy ice.  OVERALL: Would stay here again if interested in being away from the Strip.

reviews.title: Convenient and accessible
reviews.text: We found our 1 bedroom condo comfortable and well equipped.  I do recommend checking the shower pressure, and all appliances before unpacking.  We ended up having to change rooms because of the shower head and the washer not working.  Maintenance came quickly to repair the concerns.  The Berkley is a short drive to the strip and is next door to the Silverado Casino.  It's also close to restaurants and gas stations.  We spent one day travelling to Death Valley and another at the Valley of Fire which were both worth the short drives.  The pool is open but apparently because of COVID, the hot tub was closed.  I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great Location!
reviews.text: Love The Berkley's location that next to Silverton Casino and very close to shopping area and outlet mall.  Easy access to 15 north and south.  Swimming pool was closed due to pandemic.  The power was out for 3 hours, but the resort has back up power for doors, telephones and elevators.

reviews.title: Spacious quiet spot but still close to action
reviews.text: The Berkeley was spacious and well appointed. It was very quiet and a nice place to come home to. Unfortunately the pool was closed which was disappointing. They offered use of a pool at another resort but could not answer questions about that property. We turned down cleaning while there but they should be able to provide clean towels.

reviews.title: Short Trip
reviews.text: The Resort is newer and I like the location right next to the Silverton Casino.  Because of Covid a lot of amenities were not available.  I will come back after Covid to enjoy the resort and area more.  It was also short driving distances to many golf courses in the area.

reviews.title: Excellent Vacation stay at "The Berkley, Las Vegas
reviews.text: Don't have any complaints. wonderful stay. Kids had a wonderful time. I recommend you bring the whole family. The rooms are clean and the staff are very helpful. Everyone on our trip enjoyed their stay.

reviews.title: visit family
reviews.text: was very nice and close to lot of things.  unit was clean but would have liked couch to pullout for sleeping. and table was big but wobbly.  cleaning staff were friendly and other guests that we met were very pleasant

reviews.title: Don’t miss Berkley of Las Vegas
reviews.text: Berkeley is an upstanding resort other RCI members should take notice of..people eho are particular with sheets n towels changed everyday will love the place..i think this place is undernoticed n underscored since i was talking to other owners of Berkeley and nobody seems to know what it is and where it is located..

reviews.title: Highly Recommend!
reviews.text: My daughter and I really enjoyed our stay. The facility looked and smelled clean. We didn’t have any health or safety concerns. It’s new, it’s modern so we loved it! Location is GREAT! I would stay again, as I travel often to Vegas for business. I highly recommend!

reviews.title: Nice room/suite
reviews.text: Very clean , handy to casinos, restaurants, strip. Nice Pool/Hot tub area. Had a special request for a ground floor room and that was handled perfect. Thank you to manager Johnny for making it happen. Also had a Motorhome we needed to park, and that was also handled to our satisfaction. Will come back.

reviews.title: Amazing service orientation at the Berkley
reviews.text: We've stayed in numerous timeshares through the United States including several in around the Las Vegas area.  Without any hesitation, the Berkley was one of the best experiences we've had. A vehicle is an absolute necessity to travel given the Berkley's location.   However, you will not be disappointed with the quality of the rooms, the cleanliness and the attention to service.  We had an issue with the shower head and this was immediately dealt with when we explained the situation to Caesar at the front desk.  We also did not have ice in the refrigerator and a bag of ice was delivered to our door with minutes.  Outstanding service!

reviews.title: Lack of Security
reviews.text: The property is nice but it lacks real security which can be an issue in Vegas. We were located on the 16th floor and were approached by a street person when we got off the elevator to go to our room. It took 2 calls to security before she was removed. Not a very pleasant experience.

reviews.title: Nice Room with a few issues.
reviews.text: Overall, the room was nice.  Lots of room with a full kitchen that was fully furnished with pots, dishes, etc...  The towels however felt like drying off with a piece of sandpaper.  I have never had a towel that was so rough.  Also, when you walk into the lobby it looks shabby.  There is not a single decoration, picture, or anything.  I have seen more nicely decorated lobbies in Super 8 motels   Pool is small.  For a place that is listed as a 4 star facility they need to make some improvements.  Staff and check in were great.

reviews.title: Relaxing stay
reviews.text: We were treated very well. Everything was comfortable and enjoyable This resort is very close to everything we like about Vegas. Restful relaxing quiet and friendly staff We would stay there anytime we can get away First class all the way

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The location is Village of Silverton with access to restaurants, bars, casinos s. Our suite was very nice and very clean.Great view form the 17th floor. The location is conveniently off the strip but very easy to navigate. We definitely the Berkley resort Las Vegas to couples who is looking a good time home a way from home.

reviews.title: The Berkley
reviews.text: Nice room very clean and well organized.  The pool, however, has no shade and the direct sun makes it uncomfortable to use.  The Casino is great with lots of restraunts, drinks were very good while gambling.

reviews.title: BOB & EVIE
reviews.text: Great place with casino, food and shop, off the strip.Great view form the top  floors, with the rooms very nicely appointed. the staff was more then helpful on what ever you needed.  Being off the strip, but you could drive to the center of the strip with in 15 minutes. All the major hotels have parking available at a reasonable cost. .

reviews.title: Great all around
reviews.text: The room was very nice and very clean.  The overall feel was that it was new and hardly used.  The location is off the strip but very easy to navigate to any where you want to visit either on the strip or a day trip.  Highly recommend this property!

reviews.title: Pleasure vacation
reviews.text: The Berkley is great Same condo and layout we are a custom to. It’s like being at home. Nice lock off unit for our friends. Casino and restaurants right next door. Shuttle service ti the strip and close Uber ride to Smiths grocery store. Highly recommend The Berkley

reviews.title: A great place off the strip.
reviews.text: Everything was very comfortable and clean. A safe neighborhood with shopping and a casino not far. If you are staying for a week the bedsheets are replaced. The staff was responsive to our requests. Great restaurants and coffee nearby.

reviews.title: A place to rest your head
reviews.text: So a couple years ago I wrote a review that was pretty bad for this place. We decided to give it another chance and had a somewhat better experience. The positives: room doesnt have a normal hotel smell. Staff was very friendly. Room was pretty clean and quite. Location was very ideal if you're looking to stay off the strip. The negatives: they said the bed was a queen but there is no way that small thing could have been a queen. If you try to plug in ANYTHING you cant get it into the wall plugs so good luck. Very cold water in the shower for the first couple minutes. Otherwise a decent hotel and if the price is right we may stay again.

reviews.title: Excellent apartment, value for money
reviews.text: This maybe outside of the strip but worth it for the savings on the apartment & lovely pool & sauna area. Apartment would easily sleep 4 but you could hold a party for more...... large bathroom & kitchen equiped with all you need.

reviews.title: Grand Canyon Vaca. 2019
reviews.text: The Berkeley is a great vacation resort. We loved that it is located a short drive off the strip. Convenient drive to lots of attractions. Area is more residential. Quiet, clean, great staff, surrounded with a great variety of restaurants and casinos, easy to navigate,... Just a great overall experience.

reviews.title: fabulous laid back resort with an incredible view!
reviews.text: Quiet resort just steps from the Silverton casino, which has great dining options. Good sized rooms with plenty of amenities. Nice pool, set at bath water temperatures. Recommend a high floor with a view of the Vegas strip!!

reviews.title: Great property! Please fix privacy issues!!
reviews.text: There needs to be a door between washroom and bedroom. I can’t believe a door wasn’t added when these units were built! Guests in the bedroom are disturbed by Anyone using the washroom at night! This makes no sense whatsoever! PLEASE FIX!!

reviews.title: Las-Vegas_Berkley
reviews.text: Great place off the strip...  Very nice Casino (Silverton) right next door...   If you are looking for a quiet place to relax, and still have access to the hustle/bustle of the strip, this is the place to be.

reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: I travel with my sister our last visit to Vegas was 10 years ago there are a lot of changes. Our stay at the Berkeley resort was great it’s clean staff was very friendly and accommodating and with access to Silverton Casino Resort especially shuttle service we had a very unstressful week we would definitely recommend the Berkeley.

reviews.title: Great stay at The Berkley
reviews.text: Just finished a 1 week stay for my 25th wedding anniversary and it was great. I told them it was our anniversary when I booked it and they put us on the top floor with a view of the strip. And they wished us a Happy Anniversary when we checked in. Staff was friendly throughout and it’s a really nice resort. Silverton Casino across the street is very convenient for gambling, food and some good deals. Shuttle to and from the strip is a nice perk. Overall it was a great vacation

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: Away from The Strip, but close enough if you want to go there.  Casino next door is large, clean, and doesn't stink too bad from smoke.  Easy to get to Death Valley and Red Rocks.  Short drive to the airport.  Close to decent restaurants (Bootleggers, South Pointe).

reviews.title: Beyond Expectations!
reviews.text: We stayed for a week. The Berkley is a relatively new, high quality, hi-rise condo complex. We got assigned a three room and 1½ bathroom condo. It is conveniently located off of three north/south routes near the LV strip: I-15, South LV Blvd, as well as Dean Martin Rd. just a few miles south of the strip at Blue Diamond Highway. The facility abuts the very nice Silverton Casino Resort, so one can walk there easily from your unit. For some reason we were lucky enough to be put in a top floor (18th floor) unit.  Some of the views from up there were spectacular and they had abundant and fast elevators so getting up and down 18 stories was surprisingly fast and efficient.  Surface parking was also conveniently located, abundant, and free.The condo unit included a granite-covered countertop kitchen with a full-size kitchen table and was fully applianced and fully accessorized. In addition, the unit featured two large flat screen TVs, one in the living room and one in the bedroom and there was a private washer & dryer within the unit with detergent and an iron and ironing board provided.After getting settled in the condo, we took a quick trip to a nearby Smith’s Supermarket on South LV Blvd. to get breakfast and other items such as coffee, milk, bagels, cream cheese, soft drinks, snacks, etc.After the long trip that day flying from the east coast, and the time change, and a large lunch before checking in, we were very happy to just stay in our unit the first night of our trip here.  We would stay here again if a unit were available here again.

reviews.title: Short Walk to the Casino
reviews.text: This is a great place to stay the 2BR lock out gives you two one bedroom full apartments. Each with its own Bath & Kitchen. Staff is great and very helpful.and the Pool & Hot Tub are great and not at all crowded.Its a very short walk to the Casino and Dinning at the Silverton.

reviews.title: Very Nice Las Vegas Property
reviews.text: We stayed at this location in September of 2019.  Vacation Village has a very nice propery here in Las Vegas.  The rooms were what you would expect for a Gold Crown property; nice, clean, quiet, private, etc...  Everything felt like it was new and very well maintained.  Nice big bathroom with a shower and a jacuzzi tub.  The bed and pillows were very comfortable. We would absolutely stay here again.  The swimming pool and hot tub were great!  It is on the south side of the building and it has sun on it most of the day.  You can lay out and get a good baking and then cool off in the pool.  The grounds are very clean and maintained. It was nice to be across the street from the Silverton Casino and the BassPro Shop (easy walk).  They have a shuttle that will run you down to The Strip, so you don't have to worry about parking down there in that mess and you can have a great time (drink a few) and you don't have to worry about driving back. We had a great week!

reviews.title: What a trip
reviews.text: Checking in was a huge PIA (pain in the a$$) but the rest of the stay was amazing. The suite was clean and comfortable. The rooms are very well laid out and quiet. My suite was really great. They have kitchenettes and nice large bathrooms as well as sitting area and very comfortable bed. I was happy that I had the opportunity to speak with a manager because she was able to take care of the issues that the staff were not as far as checking in went. Over all, my stay was really great. I highly recommend this hotel and will stay again!

reviews.title: Finally able to stay
reviews.text: i have been wanting t stay there since they opened. I loved it. They only have one pool but it is perfect to hang out in. The hot tub was the  biggest I have ever seen. The room was spacious. Our family loved it.

reviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Our last visit to Vegas was 30 years ago and boy has it changed. We are not gamblers but there is so much to do and see. We ventured out to state and national parks in the day and took in shows at night.  The Berkley was a great home base.

reviews.title: What a great place
reviews.text: Super  clean and quite. Staff are excellent. Out of the vegas crazy strip area. Lots of nice places to eat at the silverton next door.  Highly recommended. Excellent parking and the AC works great! We will definitely be back soon. Much nicer than the Grandview. The location is superb if you want a relaxing time in Vegas.

reviews.title: Booking experience so bad, I ended up not even staying there!
reviews.text: If I could give this hotel 0 stars, I would. The rating and experience is based on the booking process before the stay. In fact, it was so terrible that I didn't even end up staying at the hotel, hesitant to drive 6+ hours to find out my room wouldn't even be available or something of the likes.I lost all hope in this company after they gave me the runaround with my reservation for a "free" stay that I "won". I am ashamed to say I fell for their marketing scheme at first, but quickly realized I was being scammed. It took weeks to receive my confirmation, the details were wrong (and took several attempts to correct), the GM of their sales/marketing office was extremely rude and degrading to me when I tried to rebook or get a refund for my stay, and the experience was so horrendous overall that I have cancelled my stay and taken the $50.00 loss. It's not worth any more of my time to deal with such an organization, daring to scam people and take advantage of customers.I was told I could rebook or change my reservation "with no problem" but then that turned into me having to jump through several hoops to reschedule with or without a fee, due to a medical reason. I will never stay at this resort or any associated property.USE CAUTION IF YOU BOOK A STAY WITH THIS COMPANY!

reviews.title: My Berkeley stay
reviews.text: Clean and very good location & excellent staff. Rooms are clean with all appliances. Microwave was a good size. Happy to see a a dishwasher and washer and drier combo. Enough parking space next to the building

reviews.title: yes to berkeley
reviews.text: the bekeley was very clean wonderful experience staff went out of the way to make sure the experience is wonderful  great location great window views not crowded next to the casino stores and eating area close by

reviews.title: Nice, Clean and Meets Your Basic Travel Needs
reviews.text: We stayed August 4th-10th.  Front desk staff was pleasant (contrary to previous reviews) and we quickly were able to check in.  Parking was excellent (although it did seem occupancy may have been lower mid week).  Room was comfortable, good size and bed was also comfortable!  Bathroom was huge with deep soaking tub.  Also we found it quiet.   View of the strip and airport in the distance was nice. View below of truck parking across the highway was not.Only big con for us was that the hotel must must add card key guest entry only access to the doors at night. My husband had a strange encounter at dawn walking over to the Silverton with a person who appeared to have come out of the hotel resulting in in the casino calling security on the person!Otherwise it was a convenient location close to casino, fast food and grocery.

reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.text: It’s a bit off the beaten path, but a nice change of pace from the bustling strip. Our 1 bedroom unit exceeded our expectations. It is steps from the local Silverton Casino and it’s varied dining options.

reviews.title: I would say again
reviews.text: Our over all stay as a family was a good one. We stayed from Thursday-Sunday.  The hotel was always clean the staff was very helpful and friendly.  The rooms are very spacious and come equipped with everything that you might need.  The beds were very comfortable. There is just a few minor issues that I did have... One was that electricity in the bathroom and bedroom kept on shorting out every time I used my hair dryer. Second Checking out on Sunday was a challenge...the elevator was packed with others, all trying to check out at the same time. Took up 10 minutes just to get on the elevator to get down to the lobby. Last check out is at 10:00AM

reviews.title: Berkeley Las vega
reviews.text: satisfied , because  it's quite, clining and the employee very friendly I recomende other people to visiting Berkeley Las Vegas.Also now I am refer my friend with name Horacio I hope he enjoy that place like me

reviews.title: BFF bday Celebration
reviews.text: Beautiful place to stay. Loved the rooms plenty of space & had a great few. Close to everything. I had a blast we visit again. Had to separate fully equipped rooms which was great. The management staff was great. Thanks for a wonderful experience.

reviews.title: 2 weeks in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We recently stayed in The Berkley Las VegasWe stayed in an apartment on the 16th floorWe found the apartment to be very well equipped and very modern in the standard of fixtures and fittings The bed was very comfortable The bathroom was large and included a deep bath and a shower The location was very quietly and they do a free shuttle to the Las Vegas Strip, you get dropped off at the Aria Casino There is a Casino next door called the Silverton Which serves good food at a reasonable price$18 for a All You Can Eat Buffet in the Seasons restaurant

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: I booked a room at the Berkley resort in Las Vegas. Unfortunately, I came down with pneumonia and was told by my doctor not to fly. I tried contacting Vacation Village in time to cancel, but they weren't open during the hours I needed to speak to someone. When I finally reached them and explained my situation and asked if I could reschedule, they told me it would be another 50.00. I tried to get a refund, and they said it was out of the question. I even offered to get a doctors note. I can't believe how rude and unprofessional the staff were. Buyer beware and don't take any deals they have to offer! Never again! Very disappointed!

reviews.title: Good Place For A Family Or Couple
reviews.text: We stay at this location from July 4 thru the 9. Our room was very clean, except for the carpeting in the master bedroom and the entry way into the unit.  They both needed a little shampooing. We did contact the front desk and they stated they would informed the maintenance department.  We were close to shopping dining and the Las Vegas strip.  The area felt safe and secure.  There is a pool on site.  The staff was always friendly and helpful.  They did not charge for PARKING .  And there were no so called RESORT FEES.  And we were given coupons for a daily free breakfast. It help to have some form of transportation.  We will stay at this location in the future. We will like to give a big thank you to Patricia who was working the front desk when we check in.

reviews.title: Overrated & POOR Customer Service
reviews.text: My family and I decided to give The Berkley a try considering all the hype I head about this resort. First off, the reception staff (especially the short Hispanic feminine male) is EXTREMELY RUDE!!!! They could certainly use a training or two on how to provide better customer service!After checking in, I overheard a few guest talking about how this property was part of some sort of timeshare in which they paid into. We were not owners, as we booked directly through the resorts website. Nonetheless, after checking in, we were advised that they do not provide daily housekeeping or anything else for that matter. Anything we needed (i.e. laundry detergent, soap, lotion, trash bags, etc.) we would have to come down to the front desk to ask for it. Which took us by surprise considering we were charged a $25 resort fee per day (for an entire week).  The few times we had to go down to ask for items we were greeted by the short Hispanic male that had a bit too much attitude for me; and smacked his lips and rolled his eyes every time you asked him for something. I thought it was just him and his hateful demeanor towards his job...but to my surprise, everyone that we encountered that worked for the hotel did not speak or appeared to be mad at the world!
