If I was remotely interested in becoming an owner in timeshare, and The Berkley was one of the resorts listed, I would IMMEDIATELY DECLINE!The hotel itself is situated in a centralized area in close proximity to local stores (i.e. Target, .99 cent store, Big Lots, etc.) and close enough to still enjoy the strip but not deal with the traffic and madness on the strip. The location itself was the only plus about this property.The hotel room itself was clean (we had a 2 bedroom suite on the 7th floor), however, we went to open the linen for the pullout sofa, it had mold on it! Granted, we could have washed it but we were too grossed out to even take it out of the bag. Therefore, we improvised and used linen from off of the other beds. The AC in the room barely worked in on of the bedrooms which was very uncomfortable at night.Needless to say, I would not refer this hotel/“resort” to my worse enemy! If you’re looking for a suite type property, there’s nicer in the area that provides better customer service and cleaner rooms!

reviews.title: First visit
reviews.text: I was extremely pleased with the resort as well as the staff. Upon arriving at the resort and the staff greeted me with a professional but most of all a friendly greeting. Each time I went out or entered the building I was greeted with a smile and well as making me feel so special. I was on the 18th floor and my husband call it the penthouse. The room was decorated great, clean and a great view..

reviews.title: Few days in Vegas!
reviews.text: The room was great! We were on the top floor so we were able to enjoy the city views. The amenities were good and complete. The room was cozy and loved the bathroom because it has both a shower and a tub

reviews.title: Nice weekend stay
reviews.text: Visited for a weekend (2 nights) with 2 adults and 2 kids. My husband and 6 year old slept in king bed. My 3 year old and I slept on pull out sofa. The room was sparkling clean. The kitchen was fully stocked with dishes but we didn’t use them. The tub was clean and amazing. The laundry in the room was great but we didn’t use it.The parking was easy and free.We didn’t use the pool, but it looked ok- it’s basically in the parking lot.We knew we would be arriving late so we asked if we could have the pull out sofa set up and made with bedding ahead of time. We we checked in around midnight I was happy to see it was set up.Only complaints: they use some sort of strong essential oils or air freshener that gave me and my kids a pounding headache and blood red eyes. The pull out sofa is easily the most uncomfortable bed ever (but I get it, it’s a sofa bed), and the people in the room next to us partied loud from 1-5am (I get it, it’s Vegas) but I wished the walls were more insulated. With the kids, we were able to walk around and explore the fish tanks Mermaids next door. It’s close to restaurants and shopping. We didn’t go to the strip, but it was close to hiking and local parks.

reviews.title: Nice place, but heavily dependent on its surrounding amenities
reviews.text: The Berkley is a nice place, with very nice, comfortable suites. As a destination, it lacks a bit, only having a pool and not much else. It does however, have the Silverton Casino just 100 feet away, along with Bass Pro Shop and a Cracker Barrel within walking distance. It will probably be a little better in the future if they manage to sell to more owners, and decrease the freebie weekender traffic.

reviews.title: Great get-away in Vegas!
reviews.text: The property is excellently maintained.  The unit was spotless and provided with dishes, cutlery, utensils, pots and pans, appliances that would have made it easy to prepare and serve meals if I had wanted to -- I didn't.  Everything was spotless and looked brand new.  The location was great because it was away from the hustle and bustle of the casino but yet close enough to allow for that activity.

reviews.title: The Berkley
reviews.text: Very nice property.  Your biggest expense is transportation if you do not have your car.  The area around the property is very sparse but the building and units are clean, nice, and comfortable..The area is surrounded by busy highways.  We walked to Target and were very happy to get back safely!!

reviews.title: High Quality luxury units
reviews.text: Although a 3-year builidng, rooms looked brand new.  Very comfortable beds and fully furnished kitchen.  Location is 15 minutes from the Las Vegas Strip.  The Silverton Casino adjecent to the Brekley and the SouthPoint Casino 5 minutges down the hightway were nice alternatives to the Las Vegas Strip. Definitely book again.

reviews.title: Great stay at the Berkley Las Vegas
reviews.text: This was our first time staying at the Berkley in Las Vegas.Our stay was from Wednesday to Wednesday, The Berkley is just off the Las Vegas Strip but still close enough to be on the strip in minutes.We arrived Wednesday evening and right away we notice how much parking was available, very nice and convenient.Next, we went into the lobby to check-in (no line) and was greeted with friendly and very helpful staff, you couldn’t ask for nicer and very accommodating people.We got to our room on the top floor it was beautiful with an awesome view, very homie feeling. It was just my wife and myself, but the room will sleep, 4 guests. We stayed at the Grandview before which the same Company owns but I think for us The Berkley was a bit nicer and newer and wasn’t near as hectic as the Grandview. The rooms at The Berkley were super clean and the kitchen was stocked with all the pots and pans, utensils to cook a huge meal. Enough plates and settings for 4 people.The stay was very calm and relaxing. Plenty of room in the lobby and by the pool. The Silverton Casino is just right across the walkway. The Bass Pro Shop is connected to the Silverton Casino and is a super cool place to visit, they have so much, and prices aren’t that bad.  We were in and out going places in Las Vegas all the time.We meet some staff throughout our stay, and everyone was friendly and helpful with great attitudes.Overall this was a great time, you can be as relaxed or as busy as you want. My wife and I would absolutely recommend The Berkley Las Vegas for a getaway or family vacation.

reviews.title: Relaxing get away
reviews.text: A home away from home atmosphere.  The room provided a relaxing vacation. No disturbances from any neighbors. The kitchen was well organized and provided adequate supplies for the week stay. A very comfortable bed and other furniture was too. The casino was next door provided various eating restaurants and an excellent Buffet.  Location was far enough away from the Las Vegas Strip, but close enough for any day or night activities. Perfect for anyone wanting a quiet and relaxing vacation.

reviews.title: CES January 2019
reviews.text: Was in Vegas for the CES show in Jan 2019Shared a 2 bedroom suite with a friend.  Was pleasantly surprised that it was actually 2 separate identical room entrances.  Each with their own key.  Great for parent that need a little alone time and have teens. Would not suggest for families with children under 10 as the doors are heavy and there is no passthrough.  Each room had its own kitchen and dining area.  The staff was so helpful.  Parking was really convenient, directly in front of the hotel or in the multi level garage which is shared with the Silverton Casino and Hotel.if you need to use acd or dvd player make sure to reserve one asap and put your name on the wait list, if one is not available.  they only have a few to loan out.Make sure to get a players card as the eating bonus come with the card.  If you are there on a Sunday make sure and go to the restaurant with the large buffet and get the sushi.  I don’t usually go to buffets, this one has begun to change my mind.Booked thru my time share, but can also book a room on hotels.comIts way off the strip, so smoke and crowds were minimized.  When football season has started at the new  stadium this may change.

reviews.title: Now this is how to enjoy Vegas!!!
reviews.text: We booked this thru our Vacation Village Voyages and it was well worth it.  We wanted to be away from the strip but still close by, this was the place.  You could get to the South Strip or the Fremont Experience in minutes.The girls at the front desk were very helpful and accommodating.  When we got in and needed some ice to have a libation, there was some in fridge...awesome.After visiting with friends, came back went to the pool and it was great. The hot tub was not hot and that was the only draw back.The rooms we had was a king on the 17th floor and it was great...could use better pillows, maybe memory foam instead of soft ones with no support.  Beautiful rooms though.The Silverton Casino next door with a great aquarium for all to enjoy. Great place and when we return, it will be to this place.

reviews.title: Self contained little Las Vegas
reviews.text: Everything I needed was just outside the door on the property but the location was removed from the chaos and hustle and bustle of the strip but yet just a 2 minute ride away. The staff was very accommodating and the rooms were spacious and clean. Would recommend for anyone that wants to be in Vegas without having to be in the chaos of it all.

reviews.title: Fun time in Vegas
reviews.text: Me and my friends are not gamblers but we like the excitement surrounding it, drinks, music and entertainment so we picked a spot off of the strip but with a casino on the grounds. No regrets! The studio and two bedrooms are spacious and very clean. The front desk check in process was quick and accommodating. Right behind the hotel is the Silverton Casino where we received a free Buffett and $50 dining credit just to sign up for the players card. Everything is perfect except for the weather. :( It’s 60 degrees.

reviews.title: Nice Place
reviews.text: This was a very nice resort. The staff was friendly and helpful as well. The room was clean and toiletries were full. The bed was very comfortable and with a separate living space and kitchen one could sleep in peace while the others are socializing. If you are looking for a nice resort off of the strip but close enough to Lyft or Uber for cheap this is definitely a great option.

reviews.title: Pleasant stay @ Berkley
reviews.text: Location: convenient to airport, Strip, and other eating places outside of resort; plenty of parkingBuilding: unobstructed view of mountain range (from our 17th floor unit); AM/PM sun not hitting unitCleanliness of unit is excellent.

reviews.title: New  -working out the kinks ?
reviews.text: This served our purpose as a quiet place to stay in Las Vagas. It is not on 'the strip'. Tours don't pick up at the Berkley so we had to drive to other location to get tour bus. Only one bank of elevators (3 cars) for 18 floors. One check out day we had to wait 20 minutes to get down from the 18th floor at 10am! - bad design of building.

reviews.title: Week get away
reviews.text: Away from the strip but close with easy access to everything you need to see or do. Right next to Silveron Casino,. Nice casino with great restaurant selection and smoke free gaming floor. Also recommend Deans Place restaurant off the back side of resort.. Excellent all you can eat ribs on Wednesday night. A hidden gem.,

reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text: Very nice building and the units were great. Staff was good. Location just fine. My only complaint are the elevators. We were on floor 18 and the time it took for the elevators to get to us was very frustrating.

reviews.title: Very Good Resort
reviews.text: This is a pretty new resort property and the grounds are well maintained.  The 1 bedroom condo had everything we needed and we cooked in our unit about 4 nights out of 7.  We were on the 16th floor and I believe I may have had two birthdays in those elevators!  Kidding of course, but my point is there are only 3 elevators and they seems to be occupied by cleaning staff on every ride.  They stop nearly on every floor which makes a ride to 16 very slow.  The employees on the elevator were very nice.  My opinion - one of the elevators should be closed to guests and staff have access to one exclusive elevator during their busy cleaning hours.  The pool area is very busy and they post there is no lifeguard.  There should be a bigger security presence in this area.  We saw a lot of glass bottles in the pool area as well as smelled weed there everyday.  I realize it is legal in Nevada, but not at a public pool area. We were there with our Interval getaway.  We did not attend the vacation village promotion but heard from several guests that it was quite excruciating.  Our experience was - all in all - very good.

reviews.title: Pool
reviews.text: We booked this thru our RCI trade for our Mexico timeshare. We wanted a pool and hot tub. A getaway from the cold northwest.Lyft lady was confused on where to drop us off. Kept taking us to the Silverton Casino.The girls at the front desk were awesome. I don’t understand the comments I’ve read about them being rude. Our flight got us in early, I didn’t expect a room right away. But she said our room was ready and we were in our room by 11 am.Put our things away and caught a lift to the Target store for some supplies (alcohol) we ask where we could get ice and they gave us a big bag.Came back went to the pool by 2pm. Pool was great. The gate did have problems the lock to get in. Maintenance man came right away and got us in.The rooms we had was the king suite. Beautiful rooms. 17th floor great view.This place is off the strip, was fine for us. Has the Silverton Casino next door with all the restaurants you could want. Great place

reviews.title: Could easily be so much better!
reviews.text: First things first; we were not here as part of a timeshare promotion, simply booked this hotel as a hotel room with a kitchen.We arrived on a Thursday and were initially very happy with our choice.  We had a strip view room on the 8th floor - not bad!  The room, a 1 bedroom, was very nicely appointed.  Great choice, and then it went downhill ...We don't wear shoes indoors, should really rethink that at The Berkeley.  The soles of our feet were black very quickly.  The carpets had been vacuumed, but not cleaned in a very long time.  The tile floors were swept over; clean to look at, but filthy in reality.  The towels were like sandpaper, but we knew that going in from a prior review.  A quick stop at Costco on the drive in fixed that problem!Then came the weekend ...Friday is when all the timeshare presentation victims arrived for their free 3 day/2 night stay.  I don't know where the marketing occurred, but these people are NOT buying a timeshare!The door slamming (it was as if drug dealing was going on next door - the doors were slamming every 5-10 seconds), yelling kids, loud music and constant pot smoking (this is a non-smoking hotel) was unbearable.  We were "hot boxed" for 2 days.  Management didn't really seem to care; as if this was normal for them.The pool - loaded with kids on Saturday, free weekend folks!  Maybe the hot tub?  No, broken all weekend.  Upon checkout I asked to use the luggage cart.  They required I leave my driver license as collateral - who is going to steal this?Pros - free parking, coupons for breakfast (nice surprise), decent location.They did not try to rope us in to a timeshare presentation, which was much appreciated.Cons - disgustingly filthy floors, uncaring staff.  Noisy, noisy, noisy!Maybe this would be okay during the mid-week, but DO NOT book over the weekend!Hotel Management - apart from what I already said, maybe book your hotel guests on separate floor or wing than the timeshare guests!  Also, invest in some soft door closers to prevent the door slamming.

reviews.title: Vaca in Luxury
reviews.text: My stay at The Berkeley was nothing short of amazing. As soon as I found out the pool was heated, I ran out to the shopping center (which is nearby) and purchased a bathing suit. After that, the choice was to unwind in the deep jacuzzi like tub or walk-in shower large enough for 2 people. The resort is quiet and gave me a much needed break from the frenzy of NYC. This is my 2nd time staying here and I am positively going to return soon!

reviews.title: Wonderful modern spacious unit
reviews.text: Extremely satisfied with our unit, bed was comfy, everything was clean.  Check in was a breeze.  Amazing view from the 17th floor.  Grounds were well kept, staff was very helpful.  Would definately stay there again!

reviews.title: Girls Casino Getaway
reviews.text: This was our first  time at the Berkley and if was fabulous. It was clean and fresh inside and out. We had a one bedroom unit with a full kitchen overlooking the pool area and the city lights in the distance (great view). The staff was awesome, very helpful with all a questions. The Silverton Casino was right next door with it's bars, restaurants, gift shop and of course casino. It was great to find that the one bar had ladies drink free from 5-7pm nightly. We had a fabulous time and would definitely return. We ate out some time and cooked some of our meals in the kitchen other nights, BBQ's are also available if you desire. We shopped At Albertsons which was very close to where we were staying (they sell liquor and beer also).

reviews.title: Berkley Review
reviews.text: We had a great time at the Berkley. Recommend a stay at this resort. Gambling was available, golf is close and the restaurants  are very accesable. Recommend  going to the buffet, thet had great food for a reasonable price.

reviews.title: Nice clean property minutes away from Vegas strip
reviews.text: The 2-bedroom apartment suite was more than I could ask for. All amenities, new and modern. Rooms were very clean and I like the fact that the living room is tiled flooring, not carpeted. Everyday maintenance was cleaning the property and frontdesk very accommodating. The area is quiet and cozy, and really there is no need to visit the main strip, there is a Bass store, casino directly across from hotel and a weekend farmer's market. But if you do want to visit the strip it's about 6 min by car.  When in Vegas, I will add the Berkley again to our destination.

reviews.title: Berkley
reviews.text: Place is new beautifully decorated.All the amenities one would need.Easy to get anywhere from here .Weather was not the best but no one has control of that.We had 2 full units for 2 of a and b both beautiful spacious and clean.

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: I had a studio which was very clean with a large bathroom. All amenities were provided including a sitting area, small kitchen, two flat screen TVs and free Wifi. It was very quiet. If you don’t mind being away from the madness of the Strip, this is a great alternative.One caveat, they were going to charge me a one time “resort fee” of $25 until I pointed out that their Web site specifically states no resort fee. Check this out before you just automatically say okay to that charge.

reviews.title: Great Rooms
reviews.text: We had a great 2BR Lockout (Which is Two One Bedroom units) We had 4 of us in the group. They had a room with kitchen and bath. My wife and I had a room with kitchen and bath. When we wanted we could open the door and move between the two units.The Staff was great. The Pool and Hot Tub where to die for.The Silverton is just a few steps away.The Food at the Silverton is wonderful.

reviews.title: Spacious and big innsoace but small in heart
reviews.text: As one checks in to this far away lonely hotel, the sky rocketing "vegas" expectations are groundedThen a soft welcoming voice tells it all- breakfast complimentary, no house keeping,  no room service, if toiletires needed get it from front desk.Disappointed as i enered the room... it was not a room, it was a suite, fully loaded kitchen (utensils and gadgets, not groceries) a living room and a cozy bedroom with a BIG toilet/bathroom. Just awesome space configuration and the missing elements are covered upThe only disappointing element that remains is the preset three item breakfast (just nothing for the vegetarians except bread toast) without a beverage of any kinds and if desired one has to pay.Location from the strip is far but the kind of spacious suit one gets is well compensated. (Uber/lyft is just 5/7 minutes away)A Value proposition- i would say

reviews.title: Great Place & each suite feels like your own condo!
reviews.text: My spouse and I stayed here for a week pending the close of our new home here in Las Vegas.  We just relocated here from NC in November 2018.  The suites are very nice, clean, and you feel like you have your own condo.  The staff is so friendly and always willing to lend a hand or offer what we needed.  Thank you again for your hospitality. My spouse and I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again or recommend to our family & friends.

reviews.title: NIce place to stay if you don't need to be on the Las Vegas Strip
reviews.text: Located a few steps away from the Silverton, there is a casino and a few good places to eat nearby.  Nearby is a Cracker Barrel restaurant, if you like.  The huge Bass Store is also attached to the Silverton.  The Berkeley has one bedroom suites that are nicely furnished; the bedroom has a king bed and there is also a queen sofa bed in the living room.  The kitchen is fully equipped and has all the pots and pans along with the silverware and dishes and glassware.  The bathroom is large and has both a tub and separate shower.  There is a washer/dryer in the unit.  The Berkley provides bathroom and kitchen soap and detergent.  The front desk will replenish if you run low.  The Berkley has a nice pool and gym.  There is a mid-week refresh of towels during your one week stay.  Also there is $25 Resort Fee added to your stay, even with an RCI Exchange.

reviews.title: The Berkley - Vegas away from Vegas
reviews.text: The Berkley is not walking distance of the strip, you will definitely need a vehicle. The hotel's location is right across from the Silverton casino hotel and Bass Pro shop, the area is quiet.  Also, not being near strip will afford you to see life outside vegas, like the Hoover dam, grand canyon helicopter ride, train ride and ghost towns; etc.   Booked a two-bedroom suite and was quite impressed, it was clean, awesome amenities and the suite was set up like 2 separate apartments that only shared a common entry door, also loved that the living room was not carpeted but tiled flooring. It's obvious that the hotel desires a good reputation because the lobby/common areas were mopped and cleaned every day, staff was friendly and no hassle for timeshare seminars. For all guests there is a gym, pool, Jacuzzi, computer room and plenty of parking. (The parking lot also serves as a location for the weekly farmer's market.)  I'm impressed so I will not hesitate to stay again. Great job Berkley! (Only complaint was that the entry door common area's carpet needed cleaning.)

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: The units are well equipped and still feel and look new.  Love the access to the Silverton and easy drive to South Point.  Be sure to have a car as it is a necessity and learn how to travel on Dean Martin to get to strip or downtown.Only complaint was they only left one dishwasher soap in unit but girls provided extra mid week.Beds were very comfortable and pull out in living room served us well for friends to stay an extra day.

reviews.title: Berkley @ Vegas
reviews.text: Housekeeping was great but not as scheduled and had to contact front desk twice to get clean linens and towels. GREAT VIEW of the strip if you get the higher floors with a north or strip view! We were on the eigteenth floor north side. BEAUTIFUL NIGHT VIEW OF THE STRIP! Not much to see day or night if you have a south view room. Rooms are clean fresh and new.

reviews.title: I don't even know what to say...
reviews.text: I booked this hotel on bookvip. What a mess. Bookvip added charges that were not supposed to be changed. That was a headache to get refunded. Bookvip told me I had to show up with a credit card. They told me I had to attend a 30 minute conference on timeshares. I had to wait about a week to call the Berkley to verify all the info. They said I didn't need a credit card any card would work and it was a 90 minute conference. We showed up a day late for our stay but had checked in the night before, before we left for our emergency. The gentleman that checked us in was great. When we arrived back in the am we asked a lady that walked in with us who walked to the opposite side of the check in desk, where the elevator was. She completely ignored us. :/ The room was great. Cons: bathroom fan didn't work. Ice maker didn't work. Ironing board was broken. Picture in the bathroom almost fell. Pros it was stalked with everything we needed to cook and do our dishes. Room was quite lovely. We never got a call to meet about the time share conference. We parked on the backside of the hotel next to the Bass pro shop so we could see our vehicle. Bad idea. After a certain time they look those doors. Completely odd when guests use that door to use to go to and come from the casino. It was a bit confusing because no where on the building does it say Berkley. It says Silverton. Needless to say they lost a potential timeshare customer. I'll stick with the timeshare I have available through my job. I called the front desk to ask if I could extend my stay A because I really wanted to hear about the timeshare and B we decided to extend our stay in Vegas. She quoted me over $170 but told me they were booked. I paid $150 for 3/4 nights. I found a few sights that showed they had availability. :( I asked for an extended check out she said no. I told her we had to change hotels and it would be helpful since she declined to extend our stay. She extended it to 11am and told me anytime after she'd charge me over $170!!!! Upon check out I put my bags outside of the room while my daughter tried to quickly use the restroom so I wasn't over charged. This place is very uptight. Unless you're a millionaire be ready to feel out of place. Like they check your credit and base their guest treatment off of that. Next time I'll stay at another timeshare I have available to me.

reviews.title: Simply wonderful!
reviews.text: We are in Vegas for 11 days, staying at three different locations due to costs especially on Halloween.  The Berkeley is our second location and I love it.I'm writing this review from the activity center at the Berkeley.  This room has three computers, a printer, a vending machine, tables and chairs for group activities and a bathroom.  It requires a room key for entrance.My husband and I typically stay at timeshare resorts and this one did not disappoint.  It has the comforts that we appreciate.  The layout is different in that all of the "action" is next door at the Silverton Hotel and Casino.  The Berkeley hotel lobby has no chairs, tables or couches.  If you have to wait for your room, you go outside and enjoy the lovely shared grounds of the Silverton and Berkeley.Nevertheless, the Silverton has the restaurants and bars. It also has a mini art gallery and aquarium near the Mermaid Bar.  There's also a huge nature/outdoor sporting shop.  It's gigantic and is incredibly decorated.  My husband said he went to the zoo.  There are lots of actual scale replicas of various animals.  This store can really substitute as a zoo experience.The Silverton has Ladies Night daily 5P - 7P where women drink for free.  The Silverton also has a free shuttle that seats about 20 people that takes you to the Aria Hotel and Casino.  We took it yesterday and had a great time sight seeing in the Aria.  This a MUST DO.I know this review is for The Berkeley but all the action is next door.  You just sleep and enjoy your suite or 1BR unit, which is VERY COMFORTABLE.  We had a GORGEOUS view of the mountains.Besides a particular Mexican resort which shall remain nevertheless, The Berkeley is now one of our favorite resorts.

reviews.title: Respite from the hustle & bustle of Las Vegas Strip
reviews.text: We stayed at The Berkeley in South Las Vegas area. Couple year old new resort. Location is next door to Silverton Hotel & Casino. Plenty of free outdoor or garage parking. Clean and kept up well both inside and outside. There was an outdoor pool just as we entered the lobby. Nice folks, courteous, smiled & greeted us regularly, efficient, not pushy, and very accommodating. Coffee, hot water for tea, and ice water were available in the lobby. There was a small gym. Inside furnitures were well maintained, not beat up. Bathroom has all the amenities you would need. We had a view of the Las Vegas Strip in the distance. From our window, we can see airplanes regularly coming down to land at McCarran International Airport. The resort was not directly under the flight path, but close. Good soundproofing. We could hear the airplanes, but noise was not loud enough to bother usYou would definitely need a car, taxi or ride share to get anywhere. Around 15 minutes drive to get to the Strip when taking the 15 Freeway. Half an hour with surface streets. There were no restaurants on site, but there were several restaurants inside the Silverton Casino, just a two minute walk from the resort. Adjacent to Silverton Casino was Bass Pro Shops, a “supersize store” selling every outdoor toys you can think off. The South Premium Outlets Mall was 10 minutes away by car. There were many restaurants there and nearby if you don’t want to eat at the casino. Overall you would stay at The Berkley to relax, to get away from the hustle and bustle of the Las Vegas Strip.

reviews.title: Worked well for us
reviews.text: Spent a week at this property while visiting family in Las Vegas.Why it worked for us Week long stay - Enjoyed the extra room it gave us. Separate bedroom plus living room. One can sleep while the other watches TV etc.Avoid the congestion - The hotel is located a few miles south of the strip so you don't have to fight all the trafficFree parking - Got to love thatModern & clean rooms - Furnishings  were up to date and in excellent conditionHad the basic necessities we wanted - Pool, jacuzzi & exercise facilitiesFood options & gaming close by - At the Silverton Casino you have choices of half a dozen restaurants from quick options like Asian and burgers to sit down restaurants like the buffet & their steakhouseWe would definitely stay here again if we were looking to be away from the strip.

reviews.title: Great Hotel If you don't want to stay on Vegas Strip
reviews.text: Just returned from a 4 day stay at The Berkley.  Very comfortable, clean and friendly staff.  The only things that we didn't like was it was like pulling teeth when we asked for additional toilet tissue and when we asked for a cart for our bags, which was kept behind the counter, we had to leave a driver's license.  Other than that we enjoyed our stay.  The Silverton is right next door and was very nice as well.  If you want to get away from the strip this would be the perfect place.

reviews.title: First trip staying off the Strip. Amazing!!!!
reviews.text: Wonderful Stay. I recommend renting a car and staying at The Berkley resort. You can avoid being stuck on the stip your. We come once to teice a year, and wanted to get away from the Strip. We rented a car and enjoyed the spacious accommodation, loved bein able to do laundry and cook if need be. The pool was never overwhelmingly crowded. The hotel is steps away from the onsite casino which has loads of dining options. The strip is a nere 15 minute drive. Will be back again in a month or so.

reviews.title: Not for Business travelers - this is not a hotel.  It's a timeshare.
reviews.text: You can either be a timeshare - or you can be a hotel.  In this reporters opinion - you cannot be both.  I understand that by the nature of timeshares - you can't treat timeshare guests like hotel guests.  The bad news for The Berkley is you cannot treat hotel guests like timeshare guests.I show up at 9 o clock at night.  Have a perfectly acceptable check in experience until I'm directed to go over and see another woman on the other side of the lobby to get my parking pass 'validated'.  I surmise after hearing the woman speaking to another couple that the woman will try to interest me in their timeshare program.  I leave and go up to my room.I wake up the next morning, have a nice workout in their perfectly acceptable (but nothing special) gym, and then I get a phone call at 10:11 am from the front desk informing me check out is at 10 (to be fair - I did not look), and that I needed to vacate immediately.  If I did not do so, I would be charged another full days room.  After some complaining on my part, I was extended a courtesy to 11, which was positioned as the biggest favor anyone has ever done for me.  I showered as quickly as I could, only to be greeted by housekeeping around 20 mins later asking me when I was leaving.Everything on property is the same state - perfectly acceptable, but not great.  It's nice to have a room with a kitchen, but nothing is stellar.I strongly suspect the glowing reviews here are procured via some other means.  This is not a hotel.Maybe as a timeshare it is great, but as a hotel the pricing was no bargain, the location is decidedly non-central, and the treatment was not OK for a business traveler who paid a fair (but not cheap) price for a hotel room.  If the hotel was 1/2 the price, or there was some nod to having to sit through a presentation to receive a discounted room - then fair enough.  That is not how the Berkley is represented on Expedia.  It's represented as a full service hotel.  If you're looking for a 'perfectly acceptable' timeshare 20 mins from the South end of the strip - this might just be for you.Note to staff: Please spare me the auto 'thank you for reporting your experience and we're sorry you had a...' response.   As a hotel guest - I find the whole experience perfectly unacceptable.

reviews.title: Relaxing Stay Away from the Crowds
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Berkley for a week. We were in Las Vegas for a family trip. The rest of our family members were staying at a resort on the Strip where we all usually stay, but it was sold out when we tried to book our room. Someone recommended us to stay at the Berkley and we are happy that we gave it a try, we had a wonderful stay. It's a very quiet and relaxing hotel, away from the noise and with a great view of the Strip. The building is nice and simple, nothing too fancy. We were really happy and comfortable in our suite. It was really spacious and nicely furnished, we had almost everything we needed. There was not much to do at the hotel tough, there are no restaurants or bars in the building, just the pool, a great hot tub and a small gym. It was awesome to have the Silverstone right across the street. We went there almost every day as they have a nice casino, good restaurants, bars and a Starbucks. There are a lot of stores and other restaurants nearby which was really convenient. We kind of missed being right at the Strip, tough. We like to go there every day and it's like a 15 minutes drive from the Berkley. I'd recommend this hotel for people that want to have a relaxing stay away from the crowds of the Strip, better if you have a car.We'd definitely stay there again, maybe not on our next visit to Vegas, but some day im the future.My suggestions for the Management would be to heat the pool, get more equipment for the gym, decorate the lobby area where the Front Desk is, it looks too empty. Also, it would be niceif during the mid-week housekeeping service they cleaned the floor. We didn't have a mop to clean it ourselves Special thanks to Asia at the Front Desk, she was really helpful and courteous. The housekeeping staff was really good too.

reviews.title: Amazing Stay!!
reviews.text: What a beautiful hotel. I was there for 3 nights with my mother and was pleasantly surprised with this hotel. It was very busy over the weekend with multiple concerts going on and I was concerned about the noise. We never heard a peep from anyone. The beds are amazing and the staff are always smiling and there to help if needed. We rented a car as you are a bit off of the strip. There is a Target close by and lots of shopping close by. I will totally be back!!

reviews.title: Surprisingly Great Resort
reviews.text: I stayed a week at the Berkley.    I had never heard of it but the reviews on Trip Advisor were good and of all the timeshare exchanges I qualified for---this seemed to be the best.  I really was pleasantly surprised with how clean the unit was, how comfortable the bed was and the view of the strip in the distance.  It is right next door to the Silverton casino which has nice restaurants and a great fish tank with a mermaid show.  The Berkley is less than 2 years old and the newness shows.  I visited with friends so I did not use the shuttle which goes to the strip (about 2 miles away) so the fact that I did not have a car was not an issue.  I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Fun at the Berkley
reviews.text: Smaller resort, which makes it easy to get around and a comfortable feeling. Close to freeway and off the strip! Casino with restaurant easy to walk to for good food. Covered parking a plus. staff is friendly and very helpful.

reviews.title: Berkley Resort - Fun Times Off the Strip
reviews.text: My first stay at the resort was with my daughter from May 12-18. My 2nd stay was this past weekend (September 12-16) with my daughter and son-in-law. Both visits were wonderful! There were no issues. I had a quick check-in and the reservationist and other staff members were professional and courteous. My room was very nice! Loved it! I have stayed "on the strip" multiple times, but this was my 2nd time staying "off the strip." Very nice and quiet. Most importantly, NO SMOKING! I was offered a free buffet, but I failed to go downstairs to obtain the voucher. The intention was very good and I thought it was a warm gesture for staying at the resort. I received two calls from the front desk inquiring about my stay.. On my 2nd trip, I visited the Silverton casino which is a very short walk from the resort and had lunch and drinks. Overall, I would rate this resort a 4 out of 5 rating.P A Garner

reviews.title: Manipulative time share scheme
reviews.text: The hotel itself and the room was very nice - new, clean, and no issues. It's a great location - close enough to the strip and surrounding areas for driving. We would have had no complaints except that when we asked about the "free breakfast" for which we saw a sign, we were told "yes, there is a free breakfast, but it's in another hotel (South Point) just a few minutes away. And you also get a $100 gift card or another gift for attending. All you need to do is look at a room, get an update, and you're good to go." We had limited time the morning of the breakfast, so I asked if there would be a "time share presentation," because we were not interested and were already "owners of a time share." She informed us that because we were already owners, we did not have to go through any presentation, and it would only take a few minutes. When we showed up for the "free breakfast" and signed in, we shared what we had been told, to which our guide for the morning said "Ha, that's not true! The presentation takes several hours." I informed them what we had been told and that we only had 1 hour max. We were then informed that we would not get our "$100 free gift" unless we went through the presentation. I said as long as we're done in an hour. Bottom line - the "free breakfast" is a time share presentation in disguise. We were never told this, and when we asked about how much time it would take we were lied to. I had to let our guide know many times how much time I had remaining, to which she rudely replied that it most likely would not be possible. At the end when we already said "no" to the timeshare, she then called her manager who came over and proceeding to go through the presentation again! When we told him our time was up and we needed to leave - he ignored me and said it would only take a few minutes. I had to stand up and almost walk out. When he finally signed off, they sent us down to get our "free gift," which mean talking to one more "corporate representative" Yanelis Carmenell who was extremely rude when we told her we were out of time and needed to leave. She once again ignored our request and proceeded to go through her "Survey" which she told us only had 3 questions - but had 6 question - lied to again! And then tried to talk us into buying their timeshare one more time. This was a miserable experience and basically wrecked what would have been a wonderful stay at The Berkley. So, unless you're looking to buy a timeshare, don't sign up for the free breakfast.

reviews.title: beautiful hotel
reviews.text: the room was amazing, great kitchen, beautiful and clean! The one downside is they do not have housekeeping services daily; they come in every few days and change your towels (they actually just took our dirty towels, we had to go get clean ones). The bed was so comfortable and the view from the room was great! the pool & hot tub were great as well

reviews.title: Vacation while staying at the Berkley, Las Vegas
reviews.text: Me and my wife had an excellent stay at the Berkley. We were right next door to the Silverton Casino and we got perks for food & gaming for both Silverton and South port Casino's. The Berkley just opened and we received gifts and fruit baskets from their staff almost everyday.

reviews.title: Rooms are good, everything else not so much...
reviews.text: Unfortunately, I experienced too many negatives during my stay here to leave a positive review. It all began at check in. My flight arrived early and I arrived at the hotel around 10am, and even though check-in wasn’t until 4 pm, I checked to see if it was possible that they had a room available. I really didn’t except for them to have a room ready, but I did expect them to at least let me use the pool or work out room while I wait for my room to become ready. The woman at the front desk was extremely rude and said ABSOLUTELY no check in’s until 4pm and I wasn’t allowed to use any of their facilities until that time. This astounded me as any other place I has stayed has at least let me choose the facilities while I wait. I said, “Well, will you at least call me when it’s ready?” She told me no, to come back at 4pm. I was forced to waste 6 hours next door with no car at a restaurant and casino. Never had any hotel so rude about check-in. When I finally got checked in, I didn’t have one single wash cloth. When I went to the front desk to tell them, her response was, “Oh yeah, we know— we ran out of wash clothes.” Ran out? How does a hotel run out of wash clothes? So she offered me hand towels to wash my body with… They have three elevators for 18 floors which is pretty good, but during the week of my stay only one elevator was working the majority of the time. At one point we waited almost 20 minutes to go to our room. We went to the pool and saw that everyone had stripped towels to indicate those were “pool” towels. We didn’t have any of those in our room, so we went to the front desk to ask about them and they said, “We ran out of pool towels, so we put extra regular towels in your room.” Just another thing they ran out of. The front desk told us that housekeeping would come mid-week (Tuesday) to clean the room and that would be the only time she would come by. She did that while we were out and she did a good job. However, on Thursday (2 days before check out), we were in our room and she randomly comes in the room with us just sitting there—no knock, no words, no anything, just barges in. I didn’t appreciate that at all. Other than all this, the rooms were nice and updated and it was fairly quiet for Vegas…It's located within walking distance to the Silverton Casio, which provides quite a bit of food options which is nice. Not within walking distance of the strip, but that wasn't an issue for us. I am somewhere between a poor and average rating. I wish I could give it a higher rating, but the cons outweigh the pros here.

reviews.title: Adequate Resort
reviews.text: The Berkley, Las Vegas is located upon the Silverton Casino property.  The pedestrian trail is approximately 250 feet.  Covered and open parking is plentiful.  The units are basic, but adequate.  Restaurants are available inside the Silverton Casino and nearby.  A free shuttle runs a few times daily to the Aria Hotel & Casino, which is located in the South Center of the Las Vegas Strip.  A few planned activities are available for participation at the resort.  There is an activities room, with an internet café.  Tables are set-up in the room, so one could play cards or a board game.  Children are likely to find the resort boring, as planned activities are limited.  When one enters the building, you are in a corridor, with elevators on the right.  The registration is in a separate room further down the corridor on the left.  If you are going to Vegas to experience the Strip, I suggest you consider a timeshare closer to the Strip (such as the Marriott Grand Chateau, or the Hillton Grand Vacations at the Elara).  If you are considering a casino-hotel, I suggest you consider one of the numerous hotels-casinos near or on the strip.  Be prepared to spend a lot of time parking and walking from the self-park garage on the strip to the casino of choice.  Of course, valet parking is always an option (for a fixed price).

reviews.title: Well worth small drive outside the strip
reviews.text: Hi we are a family of 5 so got 2 interconnecting suites. They were spacious and clean. Hotel was modern and comfortable. No problem driving into Las Vegas and getting free parking at Treasure Island. Only criticism was that the ‘complimentary’ breakfast was very limited as only 1 meal available and wd cost about $20 dollars just for soft drinks.

reviews.title: Remodeled Casino Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel used to be the Silverton Casino hotel, in fact the sign is still on top of it. It’s about 10/15 minutes from the strip the unit that I stayed in had to be remodeled recently everything appeared to be brand new. I went for the MAGIC convention this past week. For my purposes it fit the bill. The pool is ok not great, this place is definitely great for families as the units are large in size.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.text: Great location right next to a casino yet is not at all like a casino hotel. Outstanding rooms with full kitchens and roomy baths. Only negative is our ice maker does not work and there were some amenities were missing. I still recommend this as a great place to stay.

reviews.title: Frustrated - not great for the business traveler
reviews.text: The property is a time share property, so no hotel services should be expected.  The family apartment is actually two apartments with an adjoining private hallway.  So if your taking small kids you’ll have to split up the family.  While I was there 2 of 3 elevators failed and the building has 16 floors of people with probably ~24 apts per floor, so we had 15 min wait times for the elevator car, which 10 people rushed to get in to with varying conditions of dress like dressed for dinner, hiking sweaty, and lots of wet kids and adults.  I asked for a luggage cart 4 times and never was able to get one.  The pool is way over crowded and likely will make you ill.  The kitchen is stocked with average materials, but you’ll have to shop at target or Walmart etc to get food and seasoning, etc if you want to use the kitchen. My power went off in part of my room while I was there.  It was blamed on a hair dryer in someone else’s room. They charge for the stay up front, likely to prevent early abandonment.  In general it must have been a discount week while I was there, based on the class and manners of the other guests.  Trash dumps are on 3 of the 16 floors, and ice for the fridge is only on the first floor.  There are 2 TVs but only one remote. I had the air turned down to 68, but my temp probe said it was 73.  The rooms are clean, smoking isn’t allowed in the building and parking isn’t bad, but I won’t stay here again or recommend it to anyone else.  While smoking isn’t allowed inside there were plenty of smoking and 420s outside on the sidewalks. I’m not bothering to ask for any comps, because I’m sure they have any.  I have stayed at the Silverton casino several times, and it was better, even with the casino tobacco odor.  For the price go to a real hotel.

reviews.title: Very nice resort away from city center.
reviews.text: The resort is good, with in unit washer and dryer, it is very convenient especially during extremely hot summer months. it is a bit far from the city center but a lot quieter. It is a bot hard to find because the sign

reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text: Our stay at The Berkley was great. The staff was friendly and courteous. Would definitely stay next time. Amenities were wonderful the gym had everything for a quick work out. Didn't get in the pool but it looked refreshing. Great hours for the gym and pool. We were in the 17th floor and the view was spectacular. The room was really nice it was just the perfect size.Kitchen had everything as if you were at home. Very comfortable stay.

reviews.title: LIKE NO OTHER!!
reviews.text: First time in Las Vegas with my teens and husband for a basketball tournament. The Berkley, Las Vegas exceeded my expectations! Located next to the Silverton Casino and a few steps away from Cracker Barrel, this was a perfect location and a pleasant experience. Rooms are very spacious, beautiful, with modern decorations, flat screen TV, lovely kitchen and large bathrooms! We stayed in a 1 bedroom King size bed with Queen size sofa-bed unit. It’s approximately 15-20mins  from The Luxor and Mandalay Bay. We did not rent a vehicle  as Uber and Lyft were easily accessible which saved us a lot of money in rental and gas as well as time. Not being from the area and this being our first time, this was our best option. Staying at The Berkley-Las Vegas was an awesome experience and although being in Vegas during the Summer with temps in the 118 degrees was tough I would return (maybe in the Fall) and stay at The Berkley again. I would definitely recommend staying here especially if you have young children.

reviews.title: Berkley Las Vegas
reviews.text: We spent one week at the Berkley and it was great.  The unit was very nice and the bathroom was really large.  Check-in was fast and we really appreciated not being approached about a timeshare meeting.  I had read in previous reviews that the icemaker did not work, so we just made a quick trip to the dollar store (about 5 minutes away) and bought a set of ice trays.  Problem solved.

reviews.title: CLEAN!!!!! Is my first impression.
reviews.text: I highly recommend this resort ( no pressure - no solicitation) As I walked into the expansive lobby to register I was pleased with it's cleanliness the visual effects partially brought about by the sparce furnishings.There is complimentary coffee and lemon water available. The workers are VERY pleasant but don't let your guard down, they are not that bright. You will come to see later in this review what brought about this negative opinion. But one good thing, HR is not wasting money on hiring college grads as desk personnel.After we checked in we went up to our suite and again found the word CLEAN to describe our accommodations. We had an exquisite view of the strip.I will add at this point that this resort is VERY convenient to the two major expressways and parking at the resort is plentiful and easy to find.Back to the room: there is a washer and dryer combo which makes this a delight for light packers and families with children. A full service kitchen helps to save money on not having to rush out for breakfast or order in. The nearby Silverton casino has great food service and a shuttle and groceries and fast food joints are within a miles drive. The room is contractually cleaned once, midweek through your stay. Days and times are flexible.Herein lies the problem we experienced. Asha, the desk personnel who checked us in forgot to put our suite on the list to have the room cleaned, not only once but twice during our two weeks so, the "resort" fee of $25.00 per week ( which came as a last minute surprise and check in) was to be reversed or credted back because our room was not cleaned.Do you hear the ball dropping?When we checked for our first week I agreed to pay the suprise resort fee and initialed the line on the upper right hand corner. FYI: the Cancun monarch on last Vegas Blvd also has a resort fee. But it's older and the rooms smaller. The Tahiti Village on Las Vegas blvd does NOT have a resort and is perfect for a families with children because of its beautiful and spacious pool and water works. However, parking it not good compared to the Berkley.Back to the problem: even though Asha said our room would be cleaned midweek on Wednesday at 2:00pm and wrote that on our contract she did not write it on the clipboard or notifiy the cleaning service vendor.At the end of our first week we had to "checkout" and reregister for our second week. At this time I complained about the lack of cleaning and asked that I not be charged the resort fee.When I filled out the second week's contract I DID NOT INITIAL the upper right hand corner agreeing to the resort fee and scheduled a cleaning for Tuesday at 2:00pm.As it turns out this "box of rocks", again failed to notify the cleaning contractor and furthermore was charged a resort even though I had NOT authorized that charge.Manager Joy Watson to the rescue..........not really, she made empty promises and a month later had to recontact another manager at the resort to look into this matter.Now, Iresha to the rescue and YES! She did put through the credit for the unauthorized resort fee charged AND reversed the resort fee for the first week. Now that's what I call customer service. HR got their money's when they hired her.Will I go back? A resounding yes. My stay was comfortable, the resort convenient, and Iresha did what no one else could. Thank you, dear.

reviews.title: Very nice option
reviews.text: I booked a 1 - bedroom suite for a week. The rooms are large and tastefully decorated. The kitchen was decently appointed. The bathroom was very large with separate tub and shower. Given the heat wave I appreciated that the air conditioning was efficient and quiet. Parking was provided south of the building and was monitored by security from the Silverton Casino. The only amenity is a swimming pool that was well used on weekends.

reviews.title: the berkley at silverton casino, las vegas
reviews.text: huge condo with full kitchen, separate tub/shower, big bathroom, living/eating areas, 2 vanity sinks (one in main bath, other as makeup area), 2 TV's, sofa bed for additional 2 people, king size bed, lots of drawer space -- next door is the silverton casino which provides a complimentary shuttle to the aria casino on the strip, location is a bit south of the strip, nearby is a chipotle restaurant, a 99cents store for groceries, jack in the box, mcdonald's, target witin 10 min walk.  has a nice pool, gym, ice, snack machines.property is 2 years old and units are clean and well maintained.  this is a time share property and if staying for a week will get one "pickup" session a week -- linen gets changed, garbage taken -- that's it.  resort fee is $ 25 for the stay.great for a family stay.  business, was a bit of a hassle to get to the strip in the mornings having to take a taxi as the shuttle starts at 10 am

reviews.title: This is a really great place to stay in Las Vegas if you do not want the hassle of the Strip.
reviews.text: I wasn't sure what to expect given some of the reviews, but thought I'd try it.  I was in a one bedroom, condo-type unit. I stayed for a week on a timeshare getaway.   It was brand new, very impressive contemporary furnishings. Have to say I had a rental car so it was easy for me to navigate around. But if you like the strip, I understand there is a shuttle.  The strip is only a few miles away.  I hike in Red Rock Canyon so this was a very convenient location.  The staff was superb, very willing to answer any questions.  Coffee and tea available in the lobby 24 hrs.  To those who complained about no ice machine in the frig, get over it.  Go downstairs and get all the ice you want.  You will not be catered to as far as housekeeping, but you can get anything you need at the desk. The views are fabulous from the big picture windows.  i will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Almost a 5
reviews.text: Very nice place away from the crowded Las Vegas. You definitely would need to rent to figure out your transportation needs. It’s next door to The Silverton Casino for your dining and entertainment. I would definitely a do over.

reviews.title: Outstanding Value
reviews.text: I hesitate to say how much I enjoyed this place for fear that it will get booked more often and I won't be able to keep coming here. But I have to say that it is one of the nicest hotels we have ever stayed in. Rooms are very large and comfy. The layout of the hotel allows for easy access to all amenities. Parking is free and close to hotel entrance. And it is close enough to the strip to visit without being so close that you have to endure the crazy traffic and party animals. We will definitely be back.

reviews.title: relaxing resort
reviews.text: new everything at the resort. next door to the casino. lots of free parking. easy on and off from the freeway. very nice pool. but lacking furniture in the reception area and all the in room ice makers not working

reviews.title: Clean and spacious new hotel
reviews.text: The Berkley is very new and the place is clean and spacious. We were on the 18th floor so we had a wonderful view of Las Vegas. My only concern is we kept getting shocked with the key card while trying to open the room door. Maybe because its a new hotel with the carpets. The staff tried many times to rectify the problem but no luck. Hopefully, when I return again to The Berkley that problem can be solved because it was getting really annoyed and frightening being zapped all the time. Tip: walk over to the casino to get the free shuttle to the strip.

reviews.title: NICE TIMESHARE PLACE
reviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights last week.  I have stayed at a few timeshare places in Las Vegas and this place is very nice.It is located off the strip about a 10 minute drive to the strip.  I did not see if they has a shuttle.  It is located on the grounds of the Silverton Casino and although it does not have direct indoor access it is literally a 1 min walk into the casino.  For a off strip casino Silverton is very nice and not like other off strip places it is connected to a big bass pro shop retail location on one end.We had a one bedroom unit it was very nice well appointed and the beds were comfortable.  The living room funiture was a little hard but I know they do that to make sure it lasts.  The kitchen layout was one of the better ones I have seen.The pool location is out front right beside the parking lot.   This resort is new so the plants have not built up yet when they do you will have more privacy in the pool.There was a festival running in the parking lot on one end on the resort when we arrived which was very loud and have live bands playing.  The first night music went on to early morning so I had to wear ear plugs to sleep.  In the future should the hotel have an event like that next door they should inform guest at booking and also supply guests with ear plugs.A few weird things we noticed.  When you arrive there is just one pod for the dishwasher / no ice in the fridge ( although there is a auto ice maker it is disabled and you have to go down to the lobby to get ice) one roll of toilet paper and one roll of paper towels.  They will supply you with more but you have to go down to the front desk to get it.  I am sure they are trying to feel out where things fit as a new resort I just found it a little odd.This place is worth staying at and very reasonably priced.

reviews.title: UNBIASED Review!!!
reviews.text: Ok.....let me make this short so you wont lose interest. The hotel is nice and clean. I love the large bathroom and the fully loaded kitchen! I did not realize that room service is not provided and you have to wash clothes yourself during vacation....this should be posted on their website clearly! The first night there I asked one of the associates behind check-in for 10 bags of coffee to try to save them time and myself from having to ask for a few packs daily. You would have thought I asked her to help me bury a body! She acted is if I was trying to hoard/steal the HOTEL coffee! She said she could give me 5 packs and I could come back the next day....what I was trying to avoid! This hotel is not on the strip, it is about a 10 min ride from the heart of the strip! There is some really good restaurants next door to choose from......"Seasons" was very good and cheap! There "free shuttle" only goes to one or two locations and it runs only every 3 or 4 hours! I don't think I would stay here again unless I was given a really big discount! I hope I helped!

reviews.title: Tired of broken promises
reviews.text: Tired of the broken promises!  Promised jetted tub in room,not! Full kitchen and while cooking notice they have no knifes! Go down to front desk and they tell me tomorrow,meanwhile my food is cooking have to tear my steak open with bare hands,and last ,wake up  the next morning around 0627am no cable ,no tv for at least 6 hours I had it with them never again in life!stay away from the Berkeley hotel unless you are basis,and for my $$$ im not basis sorry if you on the phone with th Berkeley hotel don’t fall for there promise I’m out! reviews.title: One mile to the strip... not exactly!
reviews.text: First let me clarify... this is a great property. Clean, quiet and very well maintained. With a nice casino right next door... The Silverton. As for The Strip... you are one mile from it,but it's the south end... about 4 miles +_ from Mandalay Bay which is really the first property at the southern end of the real Strip. So, you'll need a car or be prepared to Uber or Lyft or taxi if you want to see the real action. Fremont Street is probably 15 miles..Walking to any type dining other than the casino is probably a half mile at least and it will be fast food.. McDonalds etc.So, be sure to rent a car...and be sure to have GPS

reviews.title: Good place with huge rooms
reviews.text: Ended up there as our airbnb had been cancelled las minute. We had a suite for 2 people. It is basically 2 large apartments with kitchen, washing machine and everything you’d need for a few days in Vegas. Only strage thing.... no knife in the room.About 15mn from the Strip (15$ with a lyft or uber)

reviews.title: Excellent rooms excellent service
reviews.text: If you get a dbl suite understand that this is a suite where everything is duplicate and can sleep 8 comfortably. Not one complaint from my group of 6,and we've been all over California, Miami and Las Vegas

reviews.title: The Berkley
reviews.text: The property is well located for being away from the strip, but everything is easy to get to airport ,I-15. The Strip, etc. The rooms were very comfortable and well furnished, the size of the rooms was awesome.  liked being next to the Silverton for gambling and eats.  Close to a shopping center which is handy.  We were on 17th floor facing strip so could see lights.  I'm sure we will be back again because of the easy parking, location and just being comfortable for place to stay. And price is not bad for what you get.

reviews.title: Doing laundry on vacation is AWESOME
reviews.text: I will definitely start with the good and then it will all go downhill from there. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The location was nice because it was far enough away that we didn't have any noise really. The parking was free and the hotel didn't have a gross smell. It actually had a washer and drier in the room that you didn't have to pay to use. The oversized bed was comfortable and the view was amazing. Now for the negatives. When we got there only one light worked in the bedroom. I went to unplug the lamp that did work and when I tried to plug it back in it wouldn't go. Turns out all the outlets were like this so every time we needed to plug something in you had to push on it as if we were going to break it. The towels were very starchy and scratched your skin so bad. It felt like I was drying off with a Brillo pad. Then after two days I inform them I need more towels because we were almost out. They informed me that they don't replenish the towels. That the washer and drier in the room was so YOU can wash them. Are you freaking kidding me?? So on vacation I had to wash my own towels so their lazy cleaning staff didn't have to do anything. We stayed there four days and was never visited by housekeeping. We had to once again go and ask for some more shampoo and whatnot. I half expected them to give us the ingredients and expected us to procure the products ourselves. Oh and on the way out only ONE elevator worked for 18 floors of people. We were on the 17th floor so once we finally got on it filled up by the 15th floor. Then it stopped at every single floor and we had to tell them it was full. That was the cherry on the cake. I don't think I will stay here again.

reviews.title: Niiiiice!
reviews.text: We booked 2 adjoining rooms for 6 nights. I tossed up between spending the same amount for a small room on the strip to The Berkley, which was almost 3 times the size and which meant we all got our own space.LOCATION:  It's less than a 10 minute drive to the strip. There's heaps of parking available if you have your own car. We used UBER the whole time we were there. Also, there are discounts if you use LYFT. Note: The Berkley shares the same building and entrances as the Silverton Apartments. So when you are driving there for the first time, look for the SILVERTON signage at the top of the building as there is no big Berkley signage, apart from the signs on ground level. This confused some of our Uber drivers as well. There are also 2 spots for pick up - front (MAIN) and back entrances. CHECK IN: We arrived straight from the Airport at about 1pm. Check in is 4pm. Luckliy there were 2 adjoining rooms available so we got those rooms early at no extra cost. That was a big relief after travelling 16 hours from Australia. We were on the 7th floor.Shout out to Iresha at reception for being ever so awesome during our stay there :)ROOM: Perfect! The housekeeping team have done a great job. I didn't find anything that was dirty or out of place. Our room was facing the non-strip side, but still, the views of the mountains were pretty cool. Everything in the kitchen looked brand new from the small appliances to the fridge. It had all that you needed in an apartment. The bathroom is really pretty. Clean towels, bathroom amenities, hairdryer & iron provided. The shower is big and hot/cold water + water pressure were all good. The washing machine & dryer were easy to use and washing powder is provided. The bed was soooo comfortable! Pillows were comfortable as well. There' s a lot of storage space for clothes inc. a cupboard, large chest of drawers and side tables. There's a flatscreen TV in the bedroom and the other in the lounge. The sofabed in the lounge is pretty big. There was little noise from outside our room. Even though the apartment is next the flight path, it didn't bother me (and I'm a light sleeper too). IN THE AREA: There's The Silverton Casino next door with a couple of restaurants + shops. There's a Starbucks and one of the restaurants is 24 hours.Less than 5 minute drive away are: MacDonalds, Target, Ross, In-N-Out Burger and the rest I can't remember - there's a full list of what's around in the room. GROCERIES: There's a big grocery store 5 min away called SMITH'S which is located at Desert Diamond Plaza >> See Google Maps. It was our first stop in Las Vegas. We stocked up the fridge and pantry. You can save a lot of money eating in (which we did half the time) rather than eating out for every meal of the day. WIFI: Free, strong signal & no dropouts. GYM: Open 5am to 10pm which I thought was pretty decent. Good range of cardio machines and more.  All equipment was in good working order and gym was clean. OTHER AREAS I DIDN'T USE: There's an activity/computer room. I stuck my head in, looked well equiped with a few computers and printers. Pool - I only ever saw it busy once during my stay. There are also 2 vending machines opposite the lifts. Ice maker on ground floor too. CHECK OUT: We checked out at 9am and it literally took less than 30 seconds. Really happy overall with our stay at The Berkley. Would highly recommend. Yes it's away from the strip but I was happy with the location cos sometimes you just need some quiet chill time away from the hustle and bustle.

reviews.title: Very poor service.
reviews.text: There were two women who worked the desk who were wonderful and wish I had their names but they were the best part of the stay. Very kind. The others, weren’t helpful very rude and not every accommodating. The rooms were dirty, pillows had stains on them and we had to swap out outlet cards several times bc the room keys stopped working. The construction that was going on went on late at night but they locked the automatic doors so you had to walk all the way around.  They provided us with two rolls of toilet paper. After that, you’re on your own. They wouldn’t give us more pillows or extra blankets and wouldn’t give more towels. Since there is a washer/dryer in the room you have to wash your own and they don’t give out extra. The pillows felt like sandpaper on your face. Home staff wasn’t very helpful and we were just left to fend for ourselves. I wanted to like this place. The pool was nice.  You have to use the shuttle at the silverton which is directly behind us.   I wouldn’t stay here again.  Next time, I will try somewhere else or just stay on the strip somewhere.

reviews.title: All In One Accommodation
reviews.text: To tell the truth I was not really too sure what to expect booking this location. As a solo traveller I was at the end of a vacation travelling around and wanted to find a place I could be near to the craziness of the Strip but far enough away to remain sane.The Berkley is next door to The Silverton Casino approximately a ten minute drive from the southern end of the Strip and very close to a huge Bass Pro Shop.The two high rise buildings house a number of suites that are very nicely appointed and offer all amenities to stay comfortably, whether you'd like to self cater during your stay to eat out (restaurants in the Casino). The suites are set out as self contained apartments offering secure privacy.I stayed two nights and paid a fee that would have purchased a single nights accommodation of a 4 star hotel on the strip with the bonus of a 'home feel' and the ability to cater for myself if required. Everything seemed almost new. Lovely. Access points were wide and I'm sure that people with disabilities would find this compliant.The only downside was that the building is in the flight path to McCarran Airport and at times during the day the plane noise is repetitive.I slept soundly.

reviews.title: Beautiful rooms and clean hotel all around
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I stayed here for 3 nights, 4 days. I would say that we had a great experience staying here. We stayed on the top floor, giving us a great view of the strip. Inside the room was beautiful and clean. It was nice that they do not provide housekeeping because, while we were not in the room, we were not fully comfortable with strangers entering our room. With that being said, the rooms do provide a fully stocked kitchen, plus a washer and dryer if you need to get any laundry done while on vacation. Not only was the staff friendly and helpful, they have a very nice pool with chairs actually in the water. The casino is right behind the hotel, providing a decent amount of food options. The only complaint that I have, is the shuttle to the strip. It was a little inconvenient that it only operated four times out of the day. Meaning that you would have to request the shuttle and it was a first come first serve thing. Fortunately lyft is available, we relied on that a lot and it was only about $10 to get there or back.  Other than that, I highly recommend staying at this hotel!

reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: The hotel itself it very quiet and clean. I have zero complaints. The room was clean, everything was as described.  It's definitely a place for families or people looking for a home feel. I would stay again

reviews.title: Pretty looking but once you check in it's Grey Gardens
reviews.text: Property just changed hands so the staff in the Lobby blame a lot of the issues on this. When we checked in to our 2 bedroom suite one side didn't have working light switches. We found the locked circuit breaker panel and had to call down to have a maintenance person come up (was told it would be 20 min). After waiting 30 minutes we were already heading out and stopped by the lobby to tell them our plan. That's when the Gentlemen said "1. Who did you speak to? 2. Well the maintenance team leaves at 5pm so you'll have to wait until Monday." I was DUMBFOUNDED. It was a woman who answered the phone, I don't ask for names for such a basic request, whoever answered your phone. None of the women in the lobby spoke up. This is a 17 story property, they can't have someone flip a circuit breaker? We were leaving Sunday. He actually asked me if the lights that weren't working "were very important?" I asked my friend to pinch me because I couldn't believe that this guy was NOT joking. On our last day the hotel had problems with the electric sliding doors. They locked them and put a sign on up that said out of order. I had just walked through one 10 min pervious to get a Starbucks at Silverton. There was a guest who didn't read the sign and tried to push the emergency release bar (doors were locked). I asked at the Lobby if this was a fire hazard and they said "Nope there are other exits," and she pointed to a single door on the West end of the property, a good 300 feet down the room corridor.

reviews.title: WONDERFUL STAY!!
reviews.text: My experience with The Berkley Las Vegas was a very positive one. The staff was very professional and the rooms were more than accommodating and huge! Full kitchen and washer and dryer were a great touch and would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone !!

reviews.title: Best Hotel ever
reviews.text: I won the hotel in a radio show in NY was a little skeptical at first but the room was first class it came with a full kitchen and even a washer and dryer in the room housekeeping doesn't clean the room until you check out but it was just so great the pool n everything was clean and I really enjoyed my time there

reviews.title: Fantstic for our large family
reviews.text: We had 16 people ages 8 months to 92 years gathering for a family reunion. The Berkley was perfect for us.  We were able to reserve several suites, which gave us a lot of common area to spend casual time together, but also separate bedrooms for privacy. Staff was fantastic.  Everything was new and CLEAN. Bathrooms were GREAT, big tub, big shower, 2 sinks in each bathroom.  Nice, clean pool & big hot tub.  The only cons we found were small details - only 3 sets of bath & pool towels in rooms for 4 people, ice makers didn't work in the new fridges in any of our suites (the only ice maker in the resort is on the bottom floor), no ramp into main lobby which is a pain w/ luggage, only 2 luggage carts for the entire resort which had to be checked out w/ a driver's license - DEFINITELY not nearly enough (check out was ugly), no salt/pepper, etc. - all very little details. We would definitely go again!

reviews.title: family time at a resort that's not a resort  yet
reviews.text: The 1st night was ok, the rooms are nice. but going into the next night the Bluetooth speaker didn't work but nice David got it working, also both toilets were backing up we called and they told us that the plungers were in with the washer and dryer, no one came to check on it. Also they only have 3 elevators and one ended up braking down, that was not fixed, since they are selling this as a resort I can't believe no room or maid service. when leaving we needed a cart to take our things down they only have 2 so it took us at least an hour to check out. Also some of the clerks customer service was lacking, I tried to enquire how we could get a better deal with me being and RCI member, they said nothing could be done because my niece had already booked it through booking.com they will have to do a lot before I stay there again ??

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: We found The Berkley at the last minute, but can't say enough about how much we enjoyed our stay!  There were two families (3 people in each family) and we reserved a suite.  Each family had a one bedroom condo with a little "foyer" area that connected our individual space together.  The staff were all very professional and courteous.  The rooms and common areas were exceptionally clean and our condos were well stocked.  We're thinking of making this our "go-to" place to stay the next time we visit Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Great place to stay, but a few things should be changed.
reviews.text: The property is very clean, and the rooms are perfectly maintained. This is brand new (opened around October 2016). Large units, well appointed, with large bathroom. The front desk staff was very friendly and helpful, except for the check in and check out time restrictions. My only issue was with the check in and check out times. I got there are 3:40 PM (check in time is 4:00 PM), and was told that it was not possible to check in before 4:00 PM "Because all the rooms are assigned at 4:00 PM". So I walked around for 20 minutes, then returned and had to wait as others were trying to check in. Then my room keys were pulled from a pile that was obviously ready before 4 PM. On the day of check out (check out time is 10AM), I get a call from the front desk at 9:25 AM giving me a "Friendly reminder" that check out time was "Before 10 AM". As I am getting ready to leave my unit at 10:20 AM, I have a security guard knocking on my door to make sure I am leaving. This felt pushy and unprofessional.

reviews.title: Can't Say Enough Good Things
reviews.text: From the second we checked in, the experience was 5-star. The staff was uncommonly kind and accommodating. The rooms were beautiful and fully stocked for everything you need to have a great stay. Two TV's, full kitchen, gorgeous shower and vanities, living room. It really is a mini apartment. The location was also nice. We had a great dinner at The Silverton's steakhouse called Twin Creeks and my husband spent hours at Bass Pro Shop next door. We really enjoyed the hotel's spa and pool. Overall it was a fabulous stay.
